sa: वणिजो गणिकाचारा ये चैव प्रेक्षका जनाः। सर्वांस्तान् कौरवो राजा विधिवत् प्रत्यवेक्षत॥
en: And merchants and prostitutes and spies, and those who came as sight-seers, the Kuru king looked into (the needs of) all of them, with all proper care.

sa: तत्रावहारं सम्प्राप्तं मन्येऽहं पुरुषर्षभ। श्रान्ता भीताश्च नो योधा न योत्स्यन्ति कंथचन॥
en: O foremost of men, I think, the time has come now to withdraw our army. The troops will never fight, they are tired and struck with panic".

sa: अर्थस्य पुरुषो दासो दासस्त्वर्थो न कस्यचित्। इति सत्यं महाराज बद्धोऽस्म्यर्थेन कौरवैः॥
en: O king, a man is the slave of wealth, but wealth is no one's slave. This is very true. I am bound to the Kurus by wealth.

sa: अन्तरिक्षे च शुश्राव दिव्या वाचः समन्ततः॥ कथं महात्मा गाङ्गेयः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः।
en: He then also heard divine utterance in the heaven, viz., “Why should that foremost of all wielders of weapons, Oh, why should the illustrious son of Ganga,

sa: तं तु कालमनुप्राप्तं विदित्वा पृथिवी तदा। अयाचत वरं यन्मां नरकार्थाय तच्छृणु॥
en: On one such occasion, the Earth knowing that the boon-giving hour has come, solicited a boon for her son Naraka; hear, I shall tell it to you.

sa: संजय उवाच ततः संध्यामुपास्यैव वीरौ वीरावसादने। कथयन्तौ रणे वृत्तं प्रयातौ रथमास्थितौ॥
en: Sanjaya said Then those two heroes, having adored the evening twilight, proceeded on their car talking of the incidents of that day's battle so destructive of heroes.

sa: वृणोमि त्वां महाबाहो युद्ध्यस्व मम कारणात्। त्वयि पिण्डश्च तन्तुश्च धृतराष्ट्रस्य दृश्यते॥
en: I accept you, O mighty-armed hero, fight for my cause. It appears the thread of Dhritarashtra's line, as well as his funeral cake, will rest on you.

sa: यच्छ्रुत्वा पुरुषव्याघ्रं हतं भीष्मं न दीर्यते। यस्मिन्नस्त्राणि मेधा च नीतिश्च पुरुषर्षभे॥
en: For it does not burst even on hearing the death of Bhishma that foremost of all men, in whom were intelligence and policy and skill in arms.

sa: भूमेरेते गुणा: संजय उवाच पञ्चेमानि महाराज महाभूतानि संग्रहात्। जगतीस्थानि सर्वाणि समान्याहुर्मनीषिणः॥
en: Sanjaya said O king of kings, the wise call all things in the universe as equal in consequences of the presence of the five elements (in them).

sa: तस्य शब्देन महता पाण्डवानां बलं महत्। प्राचलत् सर्वतो राजन् वातोद्भूत इवार्णवः॥
en: In consequence of those fierce roars of his, the mighty army of the Pandavas became agitated in all parts, like the ocean becoming agitated by the tempest.

sa: रणे भारत पार्थेन द्रोणो विद्धस्त्रिभिः शरैः। नाचिन्तयच्च तान् बाणान् पार्थचापच्युतान् युधि॥
en: Then, O Bharata, Drona was pierced in battle with there. shafts by the son of Pritha; but the former regarded not those arrows shot from Arjuna's bow.

sa: द्रोण उवाच न चेद् युधिष्ठिरं वीरः पालयत्यर्जुनो युधि। मन्यस्व पाण्डवश्रेष्ठमानीतं वशमात्मनः॥
en: Drona said "If in battle, the heroic Arjuna does not protect king Yudhishthira, then you may already regard the foremost of the Pandavas, brought under your control.

sa: आर्ति च परमां जगाम सह भार्यया। दशार्णपतिना सार्धं विरोधे भरतर्षभ। टा
en: But the king was nevertheless afflicted with great grief, together with his queen, O best among Bharata's race, at this enmity with the king of Dasharna territories.

sa: कर्तव्यं नाभिजानीमो निर्जिताः सव्यसाचिना॥ पाण्डवाश्च जयं लब्ध्वा परत्र च परां गतिम्।
en: And crushed completely by Savyasachin (Arjuna), we did not then know what to do. Then obtaining victory, and a highly blessed state of existence (hereafter), the Pandavas,

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अनुमानये त्वां योत्स्येऽहं गुरो विगतकल्मषः। जयेयं च रिपून् सर्वाननुज्ञातस्त्वयाऽनघ॥
en: Yudhishthira said "O preceptor, with your permission I will fight without incurring sin. O sinless one, if I get your permission, I shall (certainly) defeat my enemy.

sa: ऋषिभ्यः करकान् कुम्भान् स्थालीः पिठरमेव च। शयनासनयानानि प्रासादांश्च गृहाणि च॥ वृक्षांश्च विविधान् दद्यादन्नानि च धनानि च। सर्वे सौवर्णमेवासीद् रन्तिदेवस्य धीमतः॥
en: He gave away to the sages, including karakas and jars for water and plates and dishes and beds, carpets, conveyances, palaces and dwelling houses. And various sorts of trees and diverse kinds of edibles and viands. All the utensils and articles of the intelligent Ratindeva were made of gold.

sa: योत्स्यन्ते समरे तात संरब्धा इव कुञ्जराः। अजो भोजश्च विक्रान्तौ पाण्डवार्थं महारथौ॥
en: They will fight in the battle, my dear son, like infuriated elephants. The two powerful men, Aja and Bhoja, in the side of the Pandavas, are Maharathas.

sa: एतस्य कर्ता लोकेऽस्मिन् नान्यः कश्चन विद्यते। आग्नेयं वारुणं सौम्यं वायव्यमथ वैष्णवम्॥
en: There is none in the universe who can achieve the self-same feat. The weapons of are which the presiding deities respectively are Agni, Varuna, Soma Vayu, Vishnu,

sa: पश्यतां वो महाबाहो सेनां द्रावयति प्रभो। तं वारय महाबाहो वेलेव मकरालयम्॥
en: Is routing my army, O mighty-armed king, before your very eyes. Do you check him, O inighty-armed one, like the banks of the sea checking its fury.

sa: पुण्यं हिमवतः पादं मणिमन्तं च पर्वतम्। ज्योतिर्भिश्च समाकीर्णं सिद्धचारणसेवितम्॥ वायुवेगगतिः पार्थः खं भेजे सहकेशवः। केशवेन गृहीत: स दक्षिणे विभुना भुजे॥
en: Then it seemed that Parth held by his right arın by the lord Keshava and endued with the fleetness of the wind, reached the root of the sacred Himavat mountain teeming with gems, abounding in luminous objects and inhabited by Siddhas and Charanas. He was then accompanied by Keshava.

sa: तुष्टोऽस्मि पूजितश्चास्मि यत् काङ्क्षसि तदस्तु ते। अनुजानामि चैव त्वां युध्यस्व जयमाप्नुहि॥
en: I am very much pleased with you. I am much honoured by you. Let it be as you desire, I give you permission, fight and win victory.

sa: पाण्डवेयेषु साक्षेपं द्रोणं जानाति ते सुतः। तत: प्रतिज्ञास्थर्यार्थं स मन्त्रो बहुलीकृतः॥
en: Your son was perfectly aware of the partiality Drona cherished for the Pandavas; so to make Drona strictly redeem his promise, Duryodhana gave publicity to that counsel.

sa: यावत् कृष्णो महाबाहुः स्वाधीनः कुरुसत्तम। तावत् पार्थेन शूरेण संधिस्ते तात युज्यताम्॥
en: As long as the mighty-armed Krishna is under his own control let, O sire, O foremost the Kurus, peace be made with this heroic sons of Pritha.

sa: विद्वांसः कर्मभिः पुण्यैः स्वर्गमीहन्ति नित्यशः। न तु स्वर्गादयं लोकः काम्यते स्वर्गवासिभिः॥
en: Men possessed of knowledge always desire to attain to heaven by their performance of deeds of piety. They who live in heaven do not like this world.

sa: दृश्यादृश्या च भवति तत्र तत्र सरस्वती। एता दिव्याः सप्तगङ्गास्त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुताः॥
en: As regards the Sarasvati, in some parts she becomes visible and in some parts she disappears. This celestial seven Gangas is known all over the three worlds.

sa: शराश्च निशिताः पीता निश्चरन्ति स्म संयुगे। वनात् फुल्लद्रुमाद् राजन् भ्रमराणामिव व्रजाः॥
en: Arrows, well-sharpened and well-tempered, shot from that bow, in that battle, appeared, O king, like flights of bees coming out from a blossoming tree in a forest.

sa: संजय उवाच सौभद्रस्तद् वचः श्रुत्वा धर्मराजस्य धीमतः। अचोदयत यन्तारं द्रोणानीकाय भारत॥
en: Sanjaya said The son of Subhadra, having heard the words of the intelligent king Yudhishthira commanded his charioteer to drive his chariot against the army of Drona.

sa: निकृत्तान्येव तानि स्म समदृश्यन्त भारत। ततस्ते तु निमेषार्धात् प्रत्यपद्यन् धनूंषि च॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, we saw those bows were cut off. Then within half the time of a wink of the eye they took up other bows.

sa: भीष्म उवाच द्रौपदेया महाराज सर्वे पञ्च महारथाः। वैराटिरुत्तरचैव रथोदारो मतो मम॥
en: Bhishma said O great king, all the five sons of Draupadi are Maharathas. The son of Virata, Uttara is also a mighty Ratha; such is my opinion.

sa: राजन् कदाचिन्नास्माभिईष्टं तादृङ् न च श्रुतम्। यादृङ् मध्यगते सूर्ये युद्धमासीद् विशाम्पते॥
en: O king, that battle that raged when the sun shone on the meridian, was such that we had neither seen nor heard of its like, ever before.

sa: व्युष्टायां तु वरारोहे रजन्यां पापकर्मकृत्। न हि मोक्ष्यति पार्थात स प्रविष्टोऽप्यमरावतीम्॥
en: O beautiful lady, when the day dawns, that perpetrator of sinful acts, shall not escape the son of Pritha, even if he seeks shelter in Heaven itself.

sa: श्रेय एव परं कृष्ण लोके भवति सर्वतः। सम्भावितोऽस्मि गोविन्द त्रैलोक्येनाद्य संयुगे॥
en: I shall reap great good, O Krishna, in every respect in this world. O Govinda, today, in the three worlds, have I attained great honour in battle.

sa: ततः सा नियता भूत्वा ऋतुकाले मनस्विनी। पत्नी दुपदराजस्य दुपदं प्रविवेश ह॥
en: Thereupon that lady of great force of mind kept her mind rigidly pure and the wife of king Drupada, at the proper time went to king Drupada.

sa: स सरस्येव तं बाणं मुमोचातिबलः प्रभुः। चकार च पुनर्वीरस्तस्मिन् सरसि तद्धनुः॥
en: When the mighty and powerful Brahmacharin, shot that arrow even to the lake whence it had been brought; he also threw that bow into the self-same lake.

sa: एवं विद्वान् समुत्तिष्ठ प्रयतो भव मा शुचः। श्रुतस्ते सम्भवो मृत्योस्तपांस्यनुपमानि च॥
en: Know this as truth; rise up, grid up your loins; do not lament, you have heard of the origin of the Death and of her unequaled penances.

sa: तस्य हर्षप्रणादेन बाणवेगेन वा विभो। प्राकम्पन्त रणे योधा गाव: शीतार्दिता इव॥
en: In consequence of his rapturous roars and of the fleetness of his arrows, O master, the warriors began to shake in battle, like kine shivering with cold.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच मन्त्रयस्व महाराज नित्यं मद्धितमुत्तमम्। कामं युद्ध्य परस्यार्थे वरमेतं वृणोम्यहम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said O king, think daily of what is beneficial to me. Fight as you please with the focs. This is the boon I ask from you.

sa: प्रशशाम ततो वायुः प्रसन्नाश्च दिशो दश। ततः पाण्डुसुतो वीरस्त्रिगर्तस्य रथव्रजान्।॥ निरुत्साहान् रणे चक्रे विमुखान् विपराक्रमान्। ततो दुर्योधनश्चैव कृपश्च रथिनां वरः॥
en: The wind subsided, and points of the compass shone brightly. Thereafter that heroic son of Pandu, made the car-division of the Trigaretas despondent and destitute of prowess, and compelled them to turn their faces away a from the field of battle. Thereat Duryodhana, and Kripa that foremost of car-warriors,

sa: मामसो पुत्रहन्तेति श्वोऽभियाता धनंजयः। प्रतिज्ञातो हि सेनाया मध्ये तेन वधो मम॥
en: "He is the slayer of my son, thinking thus, tomorrow will Dhananjaya assault me. In the very midst of his troops, he has vowed to slay me.

sa: दृष्ट्वा तु क्षत्रिया भारं सैन्धवे सर्वमाहितम्। उत्क्रुश्याभ्यद्रवन् राजन् येन यौधिष्ठिरं बलम्॥
en: The Kshatriyas then beholding the king of the Sindhus take upon himself the whole burden of the onset, rushed with deafening war-cries at the divisions of Yudhishthira.

sa: तस्य सर्वे समाचष्ट यथावृत्तं नरेश्वरः। शत्रुभिर्विजयं संख्ये पुत्रस्य च वधं तथा॥
en: And then that ruler of men spoke to the Rishi all that had happened, his defeat by his foes and the slaughter of his son by them.

sa: प्रजाः सृष्ट्वा तदा ब्रह्मा आदिसर्गे पितामहः। असंतं महातेजा दृष्ट्वा जगदिदं प्रभुः॥
en: In the beginning of the creations, the Grandsire Brahma created all beings. Then that highly powerful one, seeing that the beings of his creation suffered no decay.

sa: भगिन्यौ मम ये नीते अम्बिकाम्बालिके नृप। प्रादाद् विचित्रवीर्याय गाङ्गेयो हि यवीयसे॥
en: Those two sisters of mine, Ambika, and Ambalika, who had been led away, have been made over by the son of Ganga to his younger brother Vichitravirya.

sa: पुत्रांस्तु तव सम्प्रेक्ष्य भीमसेनो महाबलः। सृक्किणी विलिहन् वीरः पशुमध्ये यथा वृकः॥
en: Then the heroic Bhimasena of superior might, beholding your sons, began to lick the corners of his mouth like a wolf in the midst of inferior beasts.

sa: ततः कृष्णोऽब्रवीत् पार्थे कृतवर्मणि मा दयाम्। कुरु सम्बन्धकं हित्वा प्रमध्यैनं विशातय॥
en: Thereafter Krishna addressing Pritha's son said-"Do not show any mercy to your kinsmen; setting at naught your relationship with him, do you slay and crush him down."

sa: तव प्रसादाद् भगवन्निदं वर्तेत् त्रिधा जगत्। अनागतममीनं च यच्च सम्प्रति वर्तते॥
en: Through your grace, O almighty Lord, the universe is divided in three divisions, viz., the Past, the Present and the Future. Let it remain as it is;

sa: सं पश्यन् हि सर्वत्र समवस्थितमीश्वरम्। न हिनस्त्यात्मनाऽऽत्मानं ततो याति परां गतिम्॥
en: For he who sees the Great Lord dwelling alike in every thing and every where, does not destroy himself by himself and thus reaches the highest goal.

sa: संजय उवाच एवमुक्तोऽर्जुन: संख्ये वासुदेवेन धीमता। अवतीर्य रथात् पार्थः स्तोत्रमाह कृताञ्जलिः॥
en: Sanjaya said Being thus addressed by the greatly wise Vasudeva, the son of Pritha, Arjuna alighted from his car and chanted the following hymn with joined hands.

sa: चरसि ज्ञातिषु सदा बिडालो मूषिकेष्विव॥ अन्यथा किल ते वाक्यमन्यथा कर्म दृश्यते।
en: You behave to your kinsmen always as the cat behaved to the mice; your words mean one thing while your acts are seen to be quite different,

sa: एवमुक्ता तु सा तेन मृत्युः कमललोचना॥ दध्यौ चात्यर्थमबला प्ररुरोद च सुस्वरम्।
en: Thus spoken to by him, that lady of lotuslike eyes, called “Death," meditated for a long time and then began to wail aloud helplessly in plaintive voice.

sa: कृर्षि च सस्यं च नरा दुदुहुः पृथिवीतले। स्वायम्भुवो मनुर्वत्सस्तेषां दोग्धाऽभवत् पृथुः॥
en: Next the men milked her when products of cultivation and crops became the milk; the selfcreate Manu became the calf and Prithu the milker, on this occasion.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच एवमेतन्महाबाहो यथा वदसि माधव। सर्वे होते न पर्याप्तास्तव वेगविधारणे॥
en: Yudhishthira said It is even so as you say, O mightv-armed descendant of Madhu's race. All these (universe) taken together are not capable of bearing your force.

sa: अस्त्राणां च धनुर्वेद ब्राह्मे वेदे च पारगम्। तं सत्य धृतिमायान्तमरुणा: समुदावहन्॥
en: Crimson steeds bore the assaulting Satyadhriti, who was proficient in the sciences dealing with the use of weapons and the bow and also in the divine Vedas.

sa: शब्देन नादिताभीक्ष्णमभवद् यत्र मे श्रुतिः। दीनानामद्य तं शब्दं न शृणोमि समीरितम्॥
en: formerly all these sounds used to strike my ears incessantly. Alas, merged as they are in grief, do not any longer here those sounds from their pavilions

sa: तमापतन्तं सहसा दृष्ट्वा प्राग्ज्योतिषो नृपः। चिक्षेप रुचिरं तीक्ष्णमर्धचन्द्रं सुदारुणम्॥
en: Beholding that lance swiftly course towards the elephant, the ruler of the Pragjyotishas, sped dreadful crescent-shaped arrow of exceeding sharpness and effulgence.

sa: तैश्चोळूतं रजस्तीव्रमवचक्रे चमू तव। ततो हतममस्याम द्रोणं दृष्टिपथे हते॥
en: Thick clouds of dust raised by them covered over your army; and our sight being intercepted, we thought Drona to be slain.

sa: ततः कार्णिमहाराज निशितैः सायकैस्त्रिभिः। आर्थ्यशृङ्गि रणे विद्ध्वा पुनर्विव्याध पञ्चभिः॥
en: Thereafter, O mighty monarch, Krishna's nephew, piercing the son of Rishyashringa with three shafts of exceeding sharpness, again pierced him with five,

sa: पितरः सहगन्धर्वाः सुपर्णाः सागरादयः। द्यौर्वियत् पृथिवीं चेयं दिशश्च सदिगीश्वराः॥
en: The ancestral manes and the Gandharvas and Suparna and the oceans, the mountains, the firmament, heaven, earth the quarters and their regents.

sa: प्रलम्बं नरकं जम्भं पीठं चापि महासुरम्। मुरं चान्तकसंकाशमवधीत् पुष्करेक्षणः॥
en: He of eyes resembling lotus petals, also slew the great Asuras, named, Pralamba, Naraka, Jamva, Peeta, as also, Mura of godlike nature.

sa: तावापतन्तौ सहितौ त्वरितौ बलिनां वरौ। अभ्यधावत वेगेन त्वरमाणो वृकोदरः॥
en: Thereupon the highly puissant Bhimasena also rushed with impetuosity against those two foremost of powerful heroes who were rushing united against himself.

sa: कथ्यतामिति सा भूयो रामेणोक्ता शुचिस्मिता। सर्वमेव यथातत्त्वं कथयामास भार्गवे॥
en: The lady, of sweet smiles being again asked to recite her story, said everything as had happened to him of Bhrigu's race.

sa: शोकार्तं तमथो ज्ञात्वा दुःखोपहतचेतसम्॥ अब्रवीत् तत्र गोविन्दो हर्षयन् सर्वपाण्डवान्।
en: Seeing the Pandava (Yudhishthira) afflicted with grief and deprived of his senses by sorrow, Govinda thus spoke giving excessive delight to all.

sa: देवलोकच्युताः सर्वे तथा विरजसो नृप। त्रयोदश सहस्राणि वर्षाणां ते जनाधिप॥१४॥ आयुःप्रमाणं जीवन्ति नरा भरतसत्तम। क्षीरोदस्य समुद्रस्य तथैवोत्तरतः प्रभुः।
en: They have all descended from the land of the celestial. O king, they are all without sin of any kind. O best of the Bharata race, the length of their life is thirteen thousand years. On the north of the milky ocean the lord.

sa: धिमां धिक् शाल्वराजानं धिग् धातारमथापि वा। येषां दुर्नीतभावे प्राप्ताऽस्यापदमुत्तमाम्॥
en: Shame on myself, shame on king Shalva, shame also on the creator through whose fault I am now placed in this difficulty.

sa: तेनार्दिता महाराज भारती सा महाचमूः। व्यभ्रमत् तत्र तत्रैव योषिन्मदवशादिव॥
en: Thus crushed by him, O monarch, the mighty army of the Bharatas, reeled here and there like a woman intoxicated with drink.

sa: चेदिपश्चित्रकेतुश्च संरब्धाः सर्व एव ते। उत्तमास्त्राणि दिव्यानि दर्शयन्तो महाबलाः॥
en: The ruler of the Chedis, and Chitraketu, all these powerful warriors wrought up with wrath, displaying their excellent weapons of celestial make,

sa: ध्वजं तु कुरुराजस्य पाण्डवस्य महौजसः। दृष्टवानस्मि सौवर्णं सोमं ग्रहगणान्वितम्॥
en: The standard of Yudhishthira endued with great energy bearing he emblem of the golden moon surrounded by the pianets, looked exceedingly charming.

sa: साधु साध्विति सैन्यानि पाण्डवेयान्यपूजयन्। ततः प्राग्ज्योतिषः क्रुद्धस्तोमरान् वै चतुर्दश॥
en: The troops of the Pandavas, all applauded Bhagadatta saying 'excellent' 'excellent'. Thereupon the ruler of the Pragjyotishas waxing wrath, with fourteen lances,

sa: निहतौ भ्रातरौ दृष्ट्वा मायाशतविशारदः। कृष्णौ सम्मोहयन् मायां विदधे शकुनिस्ततः॥
en: Then, conversant with hundred kinds of illusion, Shakuni beholding his two brothers slain spread a mighty illusion for confounding the two Krishnas.

sa: द्रोणस्य शरवर्षाणि शरवर्षेण पार्षतः॥ संनिवार्य ततः सर्वान् कुरूनप्यवधीद् बली।
en: Then that powerful son of Prishata, checking the showers of Drona's arrows with those of his own, slew many a Kuru warrior.

sa: ततस्तमः प्रादुरभूदर्जुनस्य रथं प्रति। तस्माच्च तमसो वाचः क्रूराः पार्थमभर्त्सयन्॥
en: Thereupon Arjuna's chariot was enveloped in a pall of gloom and harsh voices were heard to reproach Arjuna from within that gloom.

sa: कायेन मनसा वुद्ध्या केवलैरिन्द्रियैरपि। योगिनः कर्म कुर्वन्ति सङ्गं त्यक्त्वाऽऽत्मशुद्धये॥
en: The yoga perform actions, attaining purity of self, the body, the mind, the understanding, even the senses, being free from all attachments.

sa: स संजय महाप्राज्ञो द्रुपदस्यात्मजो बली। धृष्टद्युम्न: किमकरोच्छ्वेते युधि निपातिते॥
en: O Sanjaya, the invincible son of Drupada also is exceedingly wise. What did Dhrishtadyumna do when Shveta had been killed in battle.

sa: पञ्चालानथ मत्स्यांश्च केकयांश्च प्रभद्रकान्। भीष्मः प्रहरतां श्रेष्ठः पातयामास पत्रिभिः॥
en: That foremost of heroes, Bhishma killed with his arrows innumerable troops of the Panchalas, the Matasya's, the Kaikeyas and the Prabhadraka hosts.

sa: पश्यैतां पाण्डुपुत्राणामाचार्य महतीं चमूम्। व्यूढां दुपदपुत्रेण तव शिष्येण धीमता॥
en: “Behold, O Preceptor, the grand army of the Pandavas, drawn up in battle array by your intelligent pupil the son of Drupada.

sa: गोवत्सं वडवा सूते श्वा शृगालं महीपते। कुक्कुरान् करभाश्चैव शुकाश्चाशुभवादिनः॥
en: O king, the mare gives birth to calves the bitch to jackals. Cooks, antelopes and parrots are all sending forth inauspicious notes.

sa: विन्दानुविन्दावावन्त्यौ पञ्चभिः पञ्चभिः शरैः॥ दुर्मर्षणस्तु विंशत्या पाण्डवं निशितैः शरैः।
en: Vinda and Anuvindu pierced the son of Pandu, with five shafts each; and Durmarshana pierced him with twenty shafts of exceeding sharpness.

sa: तेषां मध्ये समासीनः प्रजापतिरपश्यत। विमान् प्रज्वलद् भासा स्थितं प्रवरमम्बरे॥
en: Seated at his ease in their midst, the lord of people, saw an excellent chariot burning with effulgence, stationed in the firmament.

sa: अत्र शूरा महेष्वासा भीमार्जुनसमा युधि। युयुधानो विराटश्च दुपदश्च महारथः॥
en: There are in it mighty bowmen, equals of Bhima and Arjuna in battle. There are Yudhishthira, Virata and the great car-warrior Drupada.

sa: विष्वग्वाताश्च वान्त्युग्रा रजो नाप्युपशाम्यति। अभीक्ष्णं कम्पते भूमिरर्कं राहुरुपैति च॥
en: Strong winds are fearfully blowing and the dust is unceasingly flying. The earth is often quaking and Rahu advances towards the sun.

sa: पुरा किल सुराः सर्वे ऋषयश्च समागताः। पितामहमुपासेदुः पर्वते गन्धमादने॥
en: In the days of yore, all the celestial and sages, assembled together, danced attendance upon the grandsire (Brahma) on the mountain Gandhamadana.

sa: युधिष्ठिरं तु कौन्तेयं महत्या सेनया वृतम्। भीष्माभिमुखमायान्तं भारद्वाजो न्यवारयत्॥
en: The son of Bharadvaja held in check that son of Kunti, Yudhishthira, who was coming upon Bhishma, surrounded by his large division.

sa: तथा भीष्मजये गृनुः सौमदत्तिस्तु पाण्डवम्। कृतप्रतिकृते यत्तौ योधयामासतू रणे॥
en: Similarly the latter longing for the victory if Bhishma, struggled with the former, both striving to counteract one another in his feats.

sa: भीमस्य च रणे राजन् धनुश्चिच्छेद भासुरम्। मुष्टिदेशे भृशं तीक्ष्णैस्त्रिभिर्भल्लैर्हसन्निव॥
en: In that battle, O king, as if smiling, Duryodhana with these arrows cut off the effulgent bow of Bhima near the grasp.

sa: नाराचेन सुतीक्ष्णेन रुक्मपुड्वेन संयुगे। उरःस्थेन बभौ तेन भीमसेनः प्रतापवान्॥
en: With a long shaft of great sharpness and golden wings. With that shaft struck on his breast, the puissant Bhimasena appeared beautiful,

sa: वर्तमाने तथा युद्धे घोररूपे भयंकरे। मोहयित्वा परान् द्रोणो युधिष्ठिरमुपाद्रवत्॥
en: When that fierce and panic inspiring battle was thus raging, Drona confounding the senses of his enemies, at last rushed at Yudhishthira.

sa: तथैव पाण्डवो राजन् भीष्मं नाकम्पयद् युधि। सात्यकिस्तु महेष्वासः कृतवर्माणमभ्ययात्॥
en: O king, that son of Pandu (Arjuna) also could not make Bhishma waver in battle. The great bowman Satyaki rushed against Kritavarma.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच अभिमन्युमहं सूत सौभद्रमपराजितम्। श्रोतुमिच्छामि कात्स्येन कथमायोधने हतः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said O Suta, I desire to hear in detail how the invincible son of Subhadra, viz., Abhimanyu was slain in battle.

sa: अपर गहुभिर्वीरा नियुद्धकुशला युधि। बहुधा सम ज्जन्त आयसैः परिचैरिव॥
en: Other heroes accomplished in battle struck one another in that battle with their bare arms, that resembled bludgeons made wholly of iron.

sa: वार्धक्षेमिं तु वार्ष्णेयं कृपः शारद्वतः शरैः। अक्षुद्रः क्षुद्रकोणात् क्रुद्धरूपमवारयत्॥
en: The generous son of Sharadvata namely Kripa, with arrows called Kshudrakas, resisted Vardhakshemi of the Vrishni race, whose very appearance reflected wrath.

sa: ताडिता भीमसेनेन शल्यस्य महती गदा। साग्निज्वाला महारौद्रा तदा तूर्णमशीर्यत॥
en: The prodigious mace of Shalya being struck against that of Bhimasena, emitted dreadful flashes of fire and then quickly fell into fragments.

sa: दुर्मुखः सहदेवं च प्रत्युद्याय महाबलम्। विव्याध शरवर्षेण यतमानं महाहवे॥
en: Durmukha rushed upon the mighty Sahadeva. He fought with him in that terrible battle and pierced him with a shower of arrows.

sa: ततस्तु तुमुलां वृष्टिं शस्त्राणां तिग्मतेजसाम्। पातयामासुरव्यग्राः पुत्रस्य तव मूर्धनि॥
en: Then these warriors, without the least flurry, poured on the head of your son a mighty shower of arrows of fierce velocity.

sa: शिखण्डिनं च पुत्रास्ते पाण्डवं च धनंजयम्। राजभिः समरे पार्थमभिपेतुर्जिघांसवः॥
en: Then your sons accompanied by other monarchs, fell upon Shikhandin and that son of Pandu namely Dhananjaya, desirous of slaying them both.

sa: सम्प्रेक्ष्य वै महाबुद्धिश्चिन्तयित्वा च भारत॥ तानब्रवीच्छान्तनवो नहां गन्ता कथंचन।
en: Then that highly intelligent Bhishma beholding them and reflecting for a while said to them, "I shall not yield up my life,

sa: अल्पायां वा महत्यां वा सेनायामिति निश्चयः। हर्षो योधगणस्यैको जयलक्षणमुच्यते॥
en: Whether the army be small or large cheerfulness of its soldiers is said to be a certain sign of its winning victory.

sa: यथाग्निरिन्धनं प्राप्य ज्वलेद् दीप्तार्चिरुल्बणम्। तथा जवाल पुत्रस्ते पाण्डुसेनां विनिर्दहन्॥
en: Just as fire fed with fuel fiercely blazes forth with terrible flames, so did your son consume the troops of the Pandavas.

sa: धनुषां कूजतां तत्र तलानां चाभिहन्यताम्। महान् समभवच्छब्दो गिरीणामिव दीर्यताम्॥
en: The twang of bows and the flapping of bowstrings mingling together, made a loud uproar which resembled the noise of splitting hills.

sa: सात्यकिश्चेकितानश्च माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ। अभिमन्युः सुविक्रान्तो वाहिनीं द्रवते मम॥
en: Satyaki, Chekitana, the twin sons of Madri by Pandu, and also Abhimanyu of great prowess, all these warriors are crushing my hosts,

sa: यत्र पार्थो महाराज भीमसेनश्च पाण्डवः। कौरव्यस्य महासेनां जघ्नतुः सुमहारथौ॥
en: Where the two mighty car-warriors, Partha and Bhimasena, the sons of Pandu, had been slaughtering the mighty divisions of the Kaurava host.

sa: शिखण्डी समरे राजन् द्रौणिमभ्युद्ययौ बली। अश्वत्थामा ततः क्रुद्धः शिखण्डिनमुपस्थितम्॥
en: O king, the mighty Shikhandin attacked Drona's son. But Ashvatthama severely wounded Shikhandin with a sharp arrows and thus made him tremble.

sa: दृष्ट्वा दुर्योधनो राजा रणे पार्थस्य विक्रमम्। त्वरमाणः समभ्येत्य सर्वांस्तानब्रवीनृपान्॥
en: King Duryodhana, beholding the prowess of the son of Pritha in that battle hastily approaching all those kings thus addressed them all:

sa: पञ्चगङ्गसु सा पुण्या कन्या वेतसकेषु च। तपोविशेषैर्बहुभिः कर्षयद् देहमात्मनः॥
en: Going then to Panchaganga and afterwards to Vetasa, that already-purified lady, pulled her own body down by performing various kinds of asceticism.

sa: तथा भीमो गजानीकं गदया समकालयत्॥ गदया वध्यमानास्ते मार्गणैश्च समन्ततः।
en: So Bhima belaboured the elephants division with his mace. smitten by that mace, as also by means of arrows on all sides,

sa: अनन्यदेवता नित्यं दृढभक्ता पितामहे। तस्थौ पितामहं चैव तोषयामास धर्मतः॥
en: Without worshipping any other god and with firin devotion to the Grandsire, she lived and propitiated him in every way and everywhere.

sa: तपनीयतनुत्राणाः संसिक्ता रुधिरेण च। संसक्ता इव दृश्यन्ते मेघसंघाः सविद्युतः॥
en: Armours of gold bespattered with blood and lying thick over the field, appeared like masses of clouds fringed with flashes of lightning.

sa: अपनीतं सुनीतं यत् तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय। यत् कृतं तत्र संग्रामे भीष्मेण जयमिच्छता॥ तेजोयुक्तं कृतास्त्रेण शंस तच्चाप्यशेषतः। तथा तदभवद् युद्धं कुरुपाण्डवसेनयोः॥ क्रमेण येन यस्मिंश्च काले यच्च यथाऽभवत्॥
en: O Sanjaya, ill or well, tell me every thing. Tell me all in full and in detail, all that was achieved in the battle of Bhishma ever desirous of victory, by that great warrior skilled in all weapons. How did the battle take place between the armies of the Kurus and the Pandavas and in what manner was the battle fought?

sa: असमागम्य भीष्मेण संयुगे किं विकत्यसे। आरुरुक्षुर्यथा मन्दः पर्वतं गन्धमादनम्॥
en: Without encountering Bhishma in battle why do you boast? Like that fool who used to boast without ever ascending the Gandhamadana mountain,

sa: एवं व्यूह्य महासैन्यं पाण्डवास्तव वाहिनीम्। अभ्यद्रवन्त संग्रामे त्यक्त्वा जीवितमात्मनः॥
en: Having thus disposed of their troops in battle-array, the Pandavas, all prepared to lay down their lives in battle, charged your divisions.

sa: तं तु सम्प्रेक्ष्य पुत्रस्ते दुर्मुखः शत्रुकर्षणः। प्रियं चिकीर्षुद्रोणस्य धृष्टद्युम्नमवारयत्॥
en: Seeing this, your son Durmukha that grinder of foes, desirous of doing an act agreeable to Drona, set himself to oppose Dhrishtadyumna.

sa: संजय उवाच श्रुत्वा मृत्युसमुत्पत्तिं कर्माण्यनुपमानि च। धर्मराजः पुनर्वाक्यं प्रसाद्यैनमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: Sanjaya said Having heard of the origin of Death and her strange deeds, the very virtuous king Yudhishthira, once more humbly addressing

sa: सेनापतिः सुशर्माणं भृशं मर्मस्वताडयत्। स चापि तं तोमरेण जत्रुदेशेऽभ्यताडयत्॥
en: Senapati sorely pierced Susarman to the very quick. The latter also struck the former on the shoulder-joint with a Tomara (or lance).

sa: शठं नैकृतिकं पापं दुराचारं सुयोधनम्॥ गृध्रोदरे वा वस्तव्यं पुरे वा नागसाह्वये। प्रतिज्ञातं मया तच्च सभामध्ये नराधम॥
en: To that vicious wretch of sinful habits, Suyodhana; "you will have to remain in the belly of a vulture or in the city called by the name of an elephant. And the resolve made by me in the council,

sa: कुन्तिभोजसुतश्चापि विन्दं विव्याध सायकैः। स च तं प्रतिविव्याध तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: The son of Kuntibhoja wounded Vinda with many arrows but he too wounded him in return. The battle they fought was wonderful.

sa: ननाद बलवान् कर्णः पार्थाय विसृजञ्छरान्। अर्जुनश्चापि राधेयं विद्ध्वा सप्तभिराशुगैः॥
en: Then Arjuna also piercing Radha's son with seven swift-flying arrows, slew the younger brothers of Karna with three shafts of great sharpness.

sa: त्यजेयं शाश्वतं धर्ममिति मे निश्चिता पतिः। सर्वे नारदप्रमुखा नृप।॥
en: Shall i abandon my eternal duty, this is my fixed resolution.” Then all those ascetics, O king, with Narada at their head,

sa: नकुलस्तु ततो वाक्यमिदमाह महीपते। उलूक ब्रूहि कौरव्यं धार्तराष्ट्र सुयोधनम्॥
en: Nakula also, O lord of the earth, then said these words; "O Uluka, O Kauravya, say to Suyodhana, the son of Dhritarashtra,

sa: तथैव शरजालानि भीष्मेणास्तानि मारिष। आकाशे समदृश्यन्त खगमानां व्रजा इव॥
en: Also, O'sire, a network of arrows woven by Bhima was seen in the heavens resembling fights of insects ranging through the skies.

sa: सादितैः सगजारोहैः सपताकैः समन्ततः। मातङ्गैः शुशुभे भूमिर्विकीर्णैरिव पर्वतैः ॥
en: The ground, strewn with mangled elephants and their drivers and with broken standards appeared as if it were covered over with hills.

sa: भीमसेनो गदां भीमा प्रकर्षन् परिघोपमाम्। प्रचकर्ष महासैन्यं दुराधर्षो महामनाः॥
en: The illustrious and invincible Bhimasena, whirling his fearful mace loO king like a parigha (weapon), seemed to crush your sons' sons' army.

sa: तस्मिन् सुतुमुले युद्धे वर्तमाने भयानके। सर्वेषामेव सैन्यानामासीद् व्यतिकरो महान्॥
en: As that dreadful and fierce battle regard, a great a confusion set in, O king, among all the ranks of the soldiers.

sa: महता रथवंशेन ते ररक्षुः पितामहम्॥ अनीकं दशसाहस्रं कुञ्जराणां तरस्विनाम्।
en: These heroes protected the grandfather (Bhishma) with a grand array of cars, with an army that consisted of ten thousand strong elephants.

sa: कृपश्च कृतवर्मा च सैन्धवश्च जयद्रथः। विन्दानुविन्दाबावन्त्यौ नाजहुः संयुगं तदा॥
en: Then Kripa and Kritavarman, and Jayadratha the ruler of the Sindhus, and Vinda and Anuvinda from Avanti, did not abandon the fight.

sa: अभिमन्युस्तत: क्रुद्धो धृष्टद्युम्ने च पीडिते। अभिदुद्राव वेगेन मद्रराजरथं प्रति॥
en: When Dhrishtadyumna was being thus fermented, Abhimanyu, inflamed with wrath, rushed with violence against the car of the king of the Madras.

sa: तौ तस्य तुरगान् हत्वा त्वरमाणौ महारथौ। छादयामासतुरुभौ शरवाण पार्षतम्॥
en: Then those mighty car-warriors both endued with greu activity, slaying the steeds of Prishata's son, shrouded him with a shower of arrows.

sa: हाहाकारश्च संजज्ञे पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम्। अभ्यद्रवत गृह्णीत हयान् यच्छत धावत।॥
en: Exclamations of Oh! and Alas! were uttered by the warriors of the Pandava army. Run, Seize, Hold the steeds, Go in haste,

sa: जघान च जनस्थाने राक्षसान् मनुजर्षभः॥ तपस्विनां रक्षणार्थे सहस्राणि चतुर्दश।
en: While in the forest of Janasthana, that foremost of men slew Rakshasas, fourteen thousand in number, for the protection of the ascetics.

sa: ततो दश महेष्वासाः पाण्डवानां महारथाः। रक्षार्थमभ्यधावन्त सौभद्रं त्वरिता रथैः॥
en: Thereupon ten great bowmen and mighty car-warriors of the Pandava (army) soon rushed on their cars to protect the son of Subhadra.

sa: सहितः सर्वतो यत्तैर्भवद्भिर्वसुधाधिपः। तच्छ्रुत्वा तु वचो राजंस्तव पुत्रस्य धन्विनः॥
en: United with all these rulers of earth, all exerting their best in battle.” Hearing those words of your son wielding the bow,

sa: मोहयित्वा ततः सैन्यं भारद्वाजः प्रतापवान्। धृष्टद्युम्नबलं तूर्णे व्यधमन्निशितैः शरैः॥
en: Then that most puissant son of Bharadvaja, stupefying the whole host, speedily blew of the division of Dhrishtadyumna with his sharpened arrows.

sa: रथयूथपयूथानां यूथपोऽयं नरर्षभः। भारद्वाजात्मजः कर्ता कर्म तीवं हितं तव॥
en: This foremost among men, the son of Bharadvaja, is the leader groups of car-leaders and will be the doer of fierce deeds.

sa: सौभद्रस्तु ततः शङ्ख प्रध्माष्य पुरुषर्षभः। शीघ्रमभ्यपतत् सेनां भारती भरतर्षभ॥
en: Thereupon, that foremost of princes viz., Subhadra's son, blowing his conch fell. O foremost of the Bharatas, upon the army of Bharatas.

sa: तमापतन्तं वेगेन प्रेरितं निशितं शरम्। भीमसेनो द्विधा राजंश्चिच्छेद विपुलासिना॥
en: O king, Bhimsena however soon with his big sword cut down that sharp arrow which was rushing towards him with great impetuosity.

sa: तथैव सात्वतो राजन् हार्दिक्यः परवीरहा। अभ्यद्रवत संग्रामे पाण्डवानां वरूथिनीम्॥
en: Also, O king, that slayer of foes, that son of Hridika, of the Satvata race, proceeded in battle against the Pandava divisions.

sa: न तथा बलवीर्याभ्यां जयन्ति विजिगीषवः। यथा सत्यानृशंस्याभ्यां धर्मेणैवोद्यमेन च॥
en: They that are desirous of victory do not so much conquer by might and prowess as by truth, compassion, piety and virtue

sa: भृशं ववौ ज्वलनसखो वियद् रजः समावृणोनमुहुरपि चैव सैनिकान्। तमेकनागं गणशो यथा गजान् समन्ततो दुतमथ मेनिरे जनाः॥
en: The friend of fire (tempest) then began to blow violently. A cloud of dust in a moment covered the firmament and the forces. People began to regard that single elephant at multiplied into many and careering in all directions.

sa: राजानं दृढधन्वानं दिलीपं सत्यवादिनम्॥ येऽपश्यन् भूरिदाक्षिण्यं तेऽपि स्वर्गजितो नराः।
en: Those who saw king Dilipa, that steady bowmen, always truthful and giving away profuse gifts at his sacrifices, succeeded in attaining paradise.

sa: लाघवेनाथ चरतः सर्वे ते सुबलात्मजाः। अन्तरं नाभ्यगच्छन्त चरन्तः शीघ्रगैर्हयैः॥
en: Those sons of Subala, riding on fleet chargers could find no opportunity for striking Iravat moving as he was with great agility.

sa: रथा रथेषु संसक्ता व्यदृश्यन्त विशाम्पते॥ एके रथं पर्यवहंस्तुरगाः सुतरङ्गमम्।
en: O king, cars were seen to mingle with cars. One car was seen upon another car and a horse upon another horse.

sa: उत्कला मेकला: पौण्ड्राः कलिङ्गान्ध्राश्च संयुगे। निषादाश्च त्रिगर्ताश्च बाह्रीकाश्च जितास्त्वया॥
en: The Utkalas, the Mekhalas, the Paundras, the Kalingas, the Nishadhas, the Trigarttas and the Valhikas, were also worsted in battle by you.

sa: तत्र कार्यतमं मन्ये भीष्मस्यैवाभिरक्षणम्। गोप्ता ह्येष महेष्वासो भीष्मोऽस्माकं महाव्रतः॥
en: Therefore I think the protection of Bhishma to be our foremost duty. This fierce bowman Bhishma of illustrious vows is our protector.

sa: ते संरब्धाः समागम्य द्विसाहस्राः प्रहारिणः। अचिराद् गमयामासुः प्रेतलोकं परस्परम्॥
en: These two thousand well-disciplined smiters, advancing with wrath. and encountering Iravat's division, were both speedily dispatched to the regions of the departed.

sa: काशिकः सुकुमारश्च नीलो यश्चापरो नृप। सूर्यदत्तश्च शङ्खश्च मदिराश्वश्च नामतः॥
en: Kashika, Sukumara, and the other ruler of men Nila and Suryadatta and Shankha and he who goes by the name of Madirashva,

sa: परिकृष्य स सेनां तु दशरात्रमनीकहा। जगामास्तमिवादित्यः कृत्वा कर्म सुदुष्करम्॥
en: Destroying the enemy's troops for ten days that slayer of heroes, having achieved most difficult feats, has now set like the sun.

sa: राक्षसोऽप्यनदद् घोरं स शब्दस्तुमुलोऽभवत्। परश्वधक्षतं रक्षः सुस्राव बहु शोणितम्॥
en: Rakshasa uttered a dreadful roar; that created a terrible sound. Cut with the strokes of the battle-axes, the Rakshasa shed blood profusely.

sa: ततो दुर्योधनो राजन् भानुमन्तमचोदयत्। सैन्येन महता युक्तं भारद्वाजस्य रक्षणे॥
en: Then king Duryodhana asked the ruler of Kalinga to go to the rescue of Bharadvaja's son with a large number of troops.

sa: प्रावर्तयत संग्रामे शोणितोदां महानदीम्। मध्येन कुरुसैन्यानां पाण्डवानां च भारत॥
en: Then, O Bharata, between the armies of the Kurus and the Pandavas, he crushed a mighty river of bloody current to flow.

sa: विषाणेन च तेनैव कुम्भेऽभ्याहत्य दन्तिनम्। पातयामास समरे दण्डहस्त इवान्तकः॥
en: And with those tusks wondering the elephants on their frontal globes felled them in battle, like the Destroyer himself wielding his mace.

sa: शैलमन्यन्महाराज घोरमस्त्रं मुमोच ह। द्रोणेन युधि निर्मुक्ते तस्मिन्नस्त्रे नराधिप।॥
en: Discharged, O mighty monarch, a terrible weapon named Shail. When, O ruler of men, that weapon was shot by Drona in battle,

sa: राक्षसानां च राजेन्द्र दुर्योधनबलस्य च। गजानीकं च सम्प्रेक्ष्य मेघवृन्दमिवोदितम्॥
en: Between the Rakshasa, O mighty monarch, and the division of Duryodhana. Beholding that elephant-division like a mass of clouds in the horizon,

sa: विराटं दुपदं चैव युयुधान् शिखण्डिनम्। पाञ्चाल्यौ च महेष्वासौ युधामन्यूत्तमौजसौ॥
en: And Virata, and Drupada and Yuyudhana and Shikhandin, and the mighty archers, rulers of Panchalas, the two Yudhamanyu and Uttamaujas (to advance).

sa: संरक्ष्यमाणो द्रोणेन मन्यते वीर्यमात्मनः। आत्मसम्भावितो मूढस्तं प्रमनीत मा चिरम्॥
en: Thus protected by Drona Abhimanyu is prizing his valour highly. Indeed he is a fool proud of himself. Crush him without delay."

sa: ततोऽहं राममायान्तं दृष्ट्वा समरकाक्षिणम्। धनुः श्रेष्ठं समुत्सृज्य सहसाऽवतरं स्थात्॥
en: I too, seeing Rama, who was desirous of fight, approaching, keeping aside that best of bows, at once dismounted from my chariot.

sa: क्षोभयन्तं तदा सेनां द्विरदं नलिनीमिव। धनंजयं भूतगणाः साधु साध्वित्यपूजयन्॥
en: Then all beings honoured Dhananjaya, who had been agitating the forces like an elephant crushing the lotus-stalks, by saying 'Well done,' 'Well-done.

sa: क्षतजोक्षितसर्वाङ्गः क्षरन् स रुधिरं रणे। बभौ रामस्तदा राजन् मेरुातुमिवोत्सृजन्॥
en: Rama, then with all his body wondered and covered all over with blood, shone in battle like a mountain dropping melted metal.

sa: सोऽन्यत् कार्मुकमादाय पौरवं निशितैः शरैः। आजघान महाराज त्रिसप्तत्या शिलीमुखैः॥
en: The latter then taking up another bow, wounded, o king, that descendant of Kuru, with seventy three sharp shafts whetted on stone.

sa: यज्ञैश्च विविधैरिष्ट्वा पृथुर्वैन्यः प्रतापवान्। संतर्पयित्वा भूतानि सर्वैः कामैर्मनः प्रियैः॥
en: Then Vena's son Prithu, possessed of prowess, celebrated various sacrifices and he gratified the hearts of creature with objects desired by them.

sa: तं श्रुत्वा निनदं घोरं भीमस्य रक्षसः। आचार्यमुपसङ्गम्य भीष्मः शान्तनवोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing that deafening roar uttered by the fearful Rakshasa, Bhishma the son of Shantanu, coming to the preceptor Drona addressed him saying.

sa: ततः सरथनागाश्वाः पुत्रास्तव जनेश्वर। परिववू रणे भीष्मं जुगुपुश्च समन्ततः॥
en: Thereupon, O ruler of men, your sons with cars, steeds, and and elephants, surrounded Bhishma in battle and began to protect him.

sa: ततो मुहूर्तात् कर्णस्य बाणेनैकेन वीर्यवान्॥ सध्वजं कार्मुकं वीरश्छित्त्वा भूमावपातयत्।
en: Then that valiant hero in a moment cutting off with a single shaft Karna's bow and standard, felled them to the ground.

sa: तदद्भुतमभूद् युद्धं द्रोणपाञ्चालयोस्तथा। नैव तस्योपमा काचिदिति मे निश्चिता मतिः॥
en: Then we beheld the marvelous fight between Drona and the Panchala prince and my firm conviction is that battle had no parallel.

sa: न केनचिदुपायेन कुरूणां दृश्यते जयः। तस्मान्मे सर्वमाचक्ष्व यथा युद्धमवर्तत॥
en: In any way, I do not see victory for the Kurus, Recount to me then, all as to how the battle raged.

sa: दृष्ट्वा तु भीमसेनस्य विक्रमं युधि भारत। अभ्यनन्दंस्त्वदीयाश्च सम्प्रहृष्टाश्च चारणाः॥
en: Beholding then the prowess of Bhimasena in battle, 0 Bharata, even your troops applauded him and the Charanas were filled with delight.

sa: एते हाहाकृताः सर्वे प्रगृहीतशरासनाः। वीरं द्रौणायनिं वीराः सर्वतः पर्यवारयन्॥
en: Then all these brave warriors crying Oh and Alas and grasping their bows and arrows surrounded Drona's brave son on all sides.

sa: तामस्य लघुतां द्रोण: समवेक्ष्य विशाम्पते। प्रहस्य सहसाविध्यत् त्रिंशता शिनिपुङ्गवम्॥
en: Then, O ruler of men, Drona beholding his light-handedness, smiled and then pierced that foremost of Sini's descendant with thirty sharp arrows.

sa: एतावदुक्त्वा भीमस्तु हर्षेण महता युतः। बाहुशब्देन पृथिवीं कम्पयामास पाण्डवः॥
en: Having spoken thus much and filled with joy, Pandu's son Bhima, caused the earth to tremble with the sound of his arm-strokes.

sa: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा द्रोणास्त्रं तत् समुद्यतम्॥ अशामयन्महाप्राज्ञो ब्रह्मास्त्रेणैव मारिष।
en: Thereupon king Yudhishthira endued with great prudence, O sire, baffled that weapon of Drona flying at himself, by invoking the Brahma weapon.

sa: ते यूयं यदि मन्यध्वमुपारमत सैनिकाः। निमीलयत चात्रैव रणभूमौ मुहूर्तकम्॥
en: O soldiers, if you like you may desist from the fight. Close your eyes, here on the field, only for a moment.

sa: आरुरोह रथं चापि सहदेवस्य मारिष। प्रयातुकामः कर्णाय वारितो धर्मनूनुना॥
en: Then quickly wheeling back, that slayer of hostile heroes viz., Prisata's son, that foremost of all car-warriors, ascended the chariot of Dhananjaya.

sa: मजन्तमिव चात्मानं धृष्टद्युम्नस्य किल्बिषे। पश्याम्यहत्वा पञ्चालान् सह तेन शिखण्डिना॥
en: I see that I am (fast) sinking into the mire of Dhristadyumna's (cunning) until I can slay the Panchalas together with Sikhandi.

sa: तेषामेतादृशी चेष्टां विज्ञाय पुरुषर्षभः। उवाच वाक्यं बीभत्सुरुच्चैः संनादयन् दिशः॥
en: Then, O foremost of men, beholding this plight of the soldiers, Vibhatsu exclaiming to the top of his voice, said these words.

sa: ततः क्रुद्धो महाराज नकुलः परवीरहा। क्षुरप्रेण सुतीक्ष्णेन कर्णस्य धनुराच्छिनत्॥
en: Thereupon, O mighty king, the highly enraged Nakula, that slayer of heroic foes, severed the bow of Karna with sharp razor-like arrows.

sa: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु देवकस्य महात्मनः। दुहितु, स्वयंवरे राजन् सर्वक्षत्रसमागमे॥
en: At this time, O monarch the Sayamvara of the daughter of the illustrious Devaka took place in which numerous Kshatriyas were present.

sa: अर्धरात्रिः समाजज्ञे निद्रान्धानां विशेषतः। सर्वे ह्यासन् निरुत्साहाः क्षत्रिया दीनचेतसः॥
en: And while their eyes were being closed in sleep, mid-night set in. Then every one became depressed and their spirits became low.

sa: गाढं विद्ध्वा शरै राजन् जयद्रथमुपाद्रवत्॥ तं समीपस्थितं दृष्ट्वा लेलिहानमिवानलम्।
en: Piercing your troops with his arrows, O king, assailed Jayadratha. Then beholding him within measurable distance like a swelling tongue of fire.

sa: महत्यपररात्रे च तव सैन्यस्य मारिष। योगो योगेति सहसा प्रादुरासीन्महास्वनः॥
en: Towards the close of the night, O lord of earth, a loud noise arose from amongst your soldiers, saying 'array and array.'

sa: व्यमुञ्चञ्छरवातान् नानालिङ्गान् समन्ततः। से तैरभ्यर्घमानस्तु भीमसेनो महाबलः॥ तेषामापततां क्षिप्रं सुतानां ते जनाधिप। रथैःपञ्चादशैः सार्ध पञ्चाशदहनद् रथान्॥
en: They discharged at himn from all sides showers of arrows of various sorts. Thus assailed by them, O king, the highly powerful Bhima soon killed fifty leading car-warriors and five hundred from amongst your sons who fell upon him.

sa: रात्रौ हि राक्षसा भूयो भवन्त्यमितविक्रमाः। बलवन्तः सुदुर्धर्षाः शूरा विक्रान्तचारिणः॥
en: Moreover, at night the Rakshasas become possessed of immeasurable prowess; the Rakshasas are by nature powerful, indomitable, heroic and energetic in battle.

sa: घटोत्कच भवांश्चैव दीर्घबाहुश्च सात्यकिः। मतो मे सर्वसैन्येषु भीमसेनश्च पाण्डवः॥
en: 0 Ghatotkacha, yourself, the long-armed Satyaki and the Pandava Bhimasena, these, according to my opinion, are the foremost among all our troops.

sa: अनुज्ञातं महावीर्यं रामेणास्त्रे सुदुर्जयम्। अग्र्यं सर्वस्य लोकस्य रथिनं लोकविश्रुतम्॥
en: Who was protected by the great archers Vrishasena and Sushena; highly energetic, powerful and taught by Rama (himself) the use of arms;

sa: वैश्यः किल समुद्रान्ते प्रभूतधनधान्यवान्॥ यज्वा दानपति: क्षान्तः स्फकर्मस्थोऽभवच्छुचिः। बहुपुत्रः प्रियापत्यः सर्वभूतानुकम्पकः॥ राज्ञो धर्मप्रधानस्य राष्ट्रे वसति निर्भयः।
en: There lived on the other side of the sea a Vaishya who rolled in wealth and corn. He performed yajnas, made liberal gifts, was quiet, observant of the duties of his own order and pure in habits and mind.

sa: अब्रवीत् पुण्डरीकाक्षो धनंजयमिदं वचः। पश्य भीमं महाबाहुं राक्षसेन्द्रवशं गतम्॥
en: The foremost of all male beings addressing Dhananjaya said these words. Behold the mighty-armed Bhima succumb to the prince of the Rakshasas.

sa: दर्शनीयो युवा चैव शौर्येण कृतलक्षणः। दुःशासनो भृशोद्विगनः प्राद्रवद् गजसंवृतः॥
en: Handsome, youthful in years and wellknown for his bravery, Dussassana inspired with great fear, fled away being surrounded by his elephant division.

sa: ततः शरसहस्रेण सम्यगस्तेन भारत। पाण्डवो व्यकिरत् कर्ण भीमो भीमपराक्रमः॥
en: Then that son of Pandu, Bhima of terrible prowess, 0 Bharata, covered Karna with thousands of arrows shot from his own bow.

sa: द्रोणस्तु बहुभिर्विद्धो बृहत्क्षत्रेण मारिष। असृजद् विशिखांस्तीक्ष्णान् कैकेयस्य रथं प्रति॥
en: O sire, Drona then pierced with numerous arrows by the Kekaya prince Vrihatkshatra, sped at his car many arrows of extreme sharpness.

sa: ततो भीमो महाबाहुर्बाहुभ्यां विक्षिपन् धनुः। व्यराजत रणे राजन्सविद्युदिव तोयदः॥
en: Then the mighty-armed Bhima stretching his bow with both his hands, appeared beautiful like a mass of clouds charged with lightning flashes.

sa: निर्भिद्य विविशुस्तूर्णं वल्मीकमिव पन्नगाः। सोऽतिविद्धो भृशं द्रौणिः पाण्डवेन महात्मना॥
en: Quickly pierced her body like snakes entering into an ant-hill. Thus deeply pierccd by the lustrious son of Pandu, Drona's son. arrows

sa: यथा हि मुखवर्णोऽयमनयोरिति मेनिरे। तव योधा महाराज हतमेव जयद्रथम्॥
en: The colour of their faces was such that your warriors, o mighty monarch, considered Jayadratha already to be one among the slain.

sa: हताश्वात्तु ततो यानादवप्लुत्य महारथः। शक्तिं चिक्षेप कर्णाय संक्रुद्ध शत्रुतापनः॥
en: Then jumping down from his horseless car that great car-warrior, the aggrandiser of his enemies, discharged a dart in anger at Karna.

sa: तत: परिष्वज्य पुनः पार्थमास्फोट्य चासकृत्। रथोपस्थगतो धीमान् प्राणदत् पुनरच्युतः॥
en: He began to dance in joy, like a tree shaken by the tempest. Then embracing Partha once more and clapping his armp-its.

sa: ततश्छिन्नायुधं तेन रणे पञ्च महारथाः॥ तं चैव निकृतिप्रज्ञाः प्राहरञ्छरवृष्टिभिः।
en: On his bow being thus cut asunder in that battle, five mighty charioteers of blunt conscience slew him with showers of arrows.

sa: दहने यत् सपुत्राया दिशि मातुस्तवानघ। द्यूतार्थे यच युष्मासु प्रावर्तत सुयोधनः॥ तस्य सर्वस्य दुष्टात्मा कर्णो वै मूलमित्युत।
en: O sinless one, in that attempt to burn your mother with all her children during the night and the behaviour that Suyodhana bore towards you during the play at dice, that wretched Karna lay at the bottom of all.

sa: अद्य मोदन्तु पञ्चाला निहतेष्वरिषु त्वया। विष्णुना निहतेष्वेव दानवेयुषु देवताः॥
en: On their enemies being slain, let the Panchalas rejoice today as did the celestials on the occasion of Vishnu's exterminating the Danavas.

sa: विनाभूत: स गदया जरासंधो महामृधे। निहतो भीमसेनेन पश्यतस्ते धनंजय॥
en: Deprived of that mace of his Jarasandha was slain in a fierce encounter by Bhimasena even before your very eyes O Dhananjaya!

sa: संजय उवाच ततः श्वेताश्वसंयुक्ते नारायणसमाहिते। तिष्ठन् रथवरे श्रीमानर्जुनः समपद्यत॥
en: Sanjaya said Then on that best of cars drawn by white horses and driven by Narayana himself the beautiful Arjuna arrived there.

sa: अभ्यद्रवन् महावेगास्ततः सैन्यं व्यदीर्यत। निहता हतभूयिष्ठाः संग्रामे निशितैः शरैः॥
en: And every body fled in great haste. The army then broke away. Many had been slain and many wounded with keen arrows.

sa: पाञ्चाल्यं विरथं भीमो हतसर्वायुधं बली। सुविषण्णं महात्मानं त्वरमाणः समभ्ययात्॥
en: Then the self-controlled Bhima beholding the prince of the Panchalas carless and weaponless, quickly rushed to the rescue of that high-souled warrior.

sa: दुर्योधन तु विरथं छिन्नवर्मायुधं रणे॥ भ्रातरः पर्यरक्षन्त सोदरा भरतर्षभा
en: Then, O foremost of the Bharata's race, Duryodhana, thus deprived of all his weapons in the battle, was protected by his brothers.

sa: महौषधिसमायुक्तं हनूपानिव पर्वतम्। तमस्य विशिखैः कर्णो व्यधमत् कुञ्जरं पुनः॥
en: Looking like Hanumat holding the (Gandhamadana) mountain over-grown with Oshadhis. But Karna, then cut that elephant, to pieces with his sharp arrows.

sa: ततः पूर्णायतोत्सृष्टैः सात्वतं युद्धदुर्मदम्॥ दुर्योधनः प्रत्यविध्यत् कुपितो दशभिः शरैः।
en: Then filled with rage Duryodhana pierced the indomitable Satyaki with numerous keen arrows shot from the bow drawn to its fullest stretch.

sa: स कृच्छू परमं प्राप्तो धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। त्यक्त्वा तत् कार्मुकं छिन्नं भारद्वाजेन संयुगे॥ आददेऽन्यद् धनुर्दिव्यं भास्वरं वेगवत्तरम्।
en: Thus the very virtuous king Yudhishthira was put in a very dangerous position. Then leaving aside his bow cut-off by Bharadvaja's son in that battle he, took up another effulgent bow of celestial make and endued with greater loughness.

sa: ततो द्रोणो महाराज नाम विश्राव्य संयुगे। शरैरनेकसाहौः पाण्डवेयान् समावृणोत्॥
en: Thereupon, 0 mighty monarch, proclaiming his name in the battle, Drona began to cover the Pandava troops with his thousands of shafts.

sa: दृष्वैतां निर्जितां सेनां रणे कर्णेन धीमता। अभियात्येष बीभत्सुः सूतपुत्रजिघांसया॥
en: Witnessing the defeat of his army by the intelligent Karna, Vibhatsu, in order to slay the charioteer's son, is advancing (against him).

sa: विसृजन् दिक्षु सर्वासु शरानसितसारथिः॥ सरथो व्यचरत् तूर्णं प्रेक्षणीयो धनंजयः।
en: Then the handsome Dhananjaya having Krishna for his charioteer, began quickly to career on the field, shooting his shafts in all directions.

sa: तं विंशतिसहस्राणि पञ्चालानां नरर्षभाः। तथा चरन्तं संग्रामे सर्वतोऽवाकिर छरैः॥
en: Thereupon twenty thousand illustrious carwarriors of the Panchala clan, covered him, thus careering on the field, with numerous shafts from all sides.

sa: तस्मिन् विनिहते चास्रे भारद्वाजो युधिष्ठिरे। वारुणं याम्यमाग्नेयं त्वाष्ट्र सावित्रमेव च॥ चिक्षेप परमाद्धो जिघांसुः पाण्डुनन्दनम्। क्षिप्तानि क्षिप्यमाणानि तानि चास्त्राणि धर्मजः॥ जघानास्त्रैर्महाबाहुः कुम्भयोनेरवित्रसन्। सत्यां चिकीर्षमाणस्तु प्रतिज्ञां कुम्भसम्भवः॥
en: That weapon being baffled by Yudhishthira, the son of Bharadvaja, in great rage, hurled at the Pandu the Varuna and Agneya,. The Teshra and the Savitra weapon, with desire of destroying him. All those weapons that were (either) hurled (or) being hurled by the Pot-born, were dauntlessly baffled by that mighty-armed and righteous one. Desirous of accomplishing his vow the Pat-born.

sa: असुरा यातुधानाश्च गुह्यकाश्च परंतप॥ ते कर्ण समपद्यन्त ह्रष्टरूपाः समन्ततः।
en: O smiter of enemies, the Asuras, the Yatudhanas, the Guhyakas and ravens and other birds who roam the skies also favoured Arjuna.

sa: तावुभो भरतश्रेष्ठौ ज्येष्ठौ सर्वधनुष्मताम्। विव्याधोरसि संक्रुद्धः पञ्चभिः पञ्चभि शरैः॥
en: Then both of those great warriors of the Bharata race and the foremost of bowmen, on the breast with five arrows each.

sa: तं द्रोणः पञ्चविंशत्या निजघान स्तनान्तरे। रोषितो भरतरेष्ठ कौन्तेयेन यशस्विना॥
en: Thus exasperated by the illustrious son of Kunti, O foremost of the Bharatas, Drona struck him on the chest with twenty-five arrows.

sa: प्रेताश्चैव पिशाचाश्च क्रव्यादाश्च मृगाण्डजाः॥ राक्षसाः सह यादोभिः श्वसृगालाश्च कर्णतः।
en: The Pretas, the Pichaches, animals and birds of prey, the Rakshasas, the sea monsters, the dogs and jackals were on Karna's side.

sa: ततोऽपरेण भल्लेन पीतेन निशितेन च। जहार नृपतेः कायाच्छिरो ज्वलितकुण्डलम्॥
en: Thereafter with a well-sharpened and welltempered arrow he severed from the trunk of that king his head graced with resplendent earrings. to

sa: ततश्चचाल पृथिवी सपर्वतवनदुमा। ववौ च विषमो वायुः सागराश्चापि चुक्षुभुः॥
en: Thereupon the earth, with its mountains, forests and trees, began to tremble. Conflicting winds began to blow and the oceans were agitated.

sa: संजय उवाच दुर्योधन कर्णमुपेत्य भरतर्षभ। अब्रवीन्मद्रराजं च तथैवान्यांश्च पार्थिवान्॥
en: Sanjaya said Thereupon, O Bharata chief, approaching Karna Duryodhana said to the Madra king as well as to other chiefs (present there).

sa: तस्मिन क्षणे पाण्डवस्य बाह्वोर्बलमदृश्यत। यत् सादिनो वारणांश्च रथांश्चैकोऽजयद् युधि॥
en: At that time Arjuna displayed the marvellous strength of his arms by destroying in battle, alone and unaided, car-warriors horsemen and elephants.

sa: तमभ्ययाद् बृहत्क्षत्रः केकयानां महारथः। भ्रातृणां नृप पञ्चानां श्रेष्ठः समरकर्कशः॥
en: Him encountered Vrihadkshatra that mighty car-warrior among the Kekayas, the eldest of his five brothers and difficult of being resisted in battle.

sa: सोमदत्तं तु संक्रुद्धो रणे विव्याध सात्यकः। सात्यकिं शरजालेन सोमदत्तोऽप्यपीड्यत्॥
en: Satyaki also, getting greatly excited with wrath, pierced Somadatta in that battle. Somadatta, on his part, afflicted Satyaki with showers of arrows.

sa: स च्छिन्नधन्वा त्वरितस्त्वराकाले नृपोत्तमः। अन्यदादत्त वेगेन कार्मुकं समरे दृढम्॥
en: Deprived of his bows, that excellent king took up another tough and strong bow, with great speed when speed was highly necessary.

sa: प्रवर्षन् निशितान् बाणान् बाहुद्रविणदर्पितः। यदर्जुनोऽभ्ययाद् द्रोणमुपपन्नं हि तस्य तत्॥
en: As Arjuna, proud of the prowess of his arms, sent forth keen darts, it was no wonder that he over came Drona.

sa: विधर्मकाणि कुर्वन्ति तथा परिभवन्ति च। तदिदं पार्षतेनेह महादाधर्मिकं कृतम्॥
en: Men perpetrate acts opposed to morality or to humiliate others. This most sinful act has been committed by the son of Prisata.

sa: तदस्यापूजयन् कर्म स्वे परे चापि संयुगे। हतसूतरथेनाजौ व्यचरद् यदभीतवत्॥
en: Then as he covered dauntlessly on the field that driverless car of his, his friends and foes alike applauded his feat. soon

sa: शल्य उवाच आतुराणां परित्याग: स्वदारसुतविक्रयः। अङ्गे प्रवर्तते कर्ण येषामधिपतिर्भवान्॥
en: Shalya said To forsake the distressed and sell children with wives are the practices of Angas whose king you are, O Karna.

sa: निवार्य तु रणे द्रोणो युयुधानं महारथम्। विव्याध निशितैर्बाणैः पञ्चभिर्मर्मभेदिभिः॥
en: Resisting that mighty car-warrior Yuyudhana in battle, Drona pierced him with five sharp arrows all capable of penetrating to the very vitals.

sa: स्ववर्त्मनि स्थितं वीर जपहोमेषु वर्तते॥ एकार्णवमिदं पूर्वं सर्वमासीत् तमोमयम्।
en: Remaining in its own course is engaged in (religious) meditation and sacrifices, Originally, buried in darkness and one vast sheet of water.

sa: स तथा पाण्डुपुत्रेण बलिनाभिहतोऽपतत्। तं निहत्य महाराज भीमसेनो महाबलः॥
en: Thus struck by the powerful son of Pandu, he fell down (from his car). The highly powerful Bhimasena, Oking, after slaying him.

sa: दुःशासनं तु विंशत्या विव्याध शिनिपुङ्गवः। अथान्यद् धनुरादाय श्यालस्तव विशाम्पते॥
en: That illustrious grandson of Sini next pierced Dushasana with twenty arrows. Thereafter O ruler of men, your brother-in-law, taking up another bow.

sa: शिखण्डिनमथायान्तं रथेन रथिनां वरम्। कृपः शारद्वतो राजन् वारयामास संयुगे॥
en: Similarly, in that encounter, Kripa, the son of Saradvata, opposed Shikhandi, the foremost of car-warriors, (who was) advancing on his car, Oking.

sa: अद्य सर्वा दिशो राजन् धाराभिरिव संकुलाः। आवृताः पत्रिभिस्तीक्ष्णैर्द्रष्टरो मामकैरिह॥
en: My troops shall today bchold the quarters of the compass, shrouded with sharp-winged shafts, as if O king, by shower of rain.

sa: धृष्टकेतुर्महाराज चेदीनां प्रवरो रथः॥ कृत्वा नसुकरं कर्म गतो वैवस्वतक्षयम्।
en: O powerful king, having achieved the most difficult feats, Dhristaketu that greatest carwarrior among the Chedis, departed to the abode of Death.

sa: तमापतन्तं सहसा निस्त्रिंशं निशितैः शरैः। पातयामास समरे सहदेवो हसन्निव॥
en: On the other hand, Shahadeva, as if laughing, had suddenly thrown down that sword with keen arrows, that was directed towards him.

sa: अचिरेण महीं पार्थश्चकार रुधिरोत्तराम्। हतभूयिष्ठयोधं तत् कृत्वा तव बलं बली॥ आससाद दुराधर्षः सैन्धवं सत्यविक्रमः। बीभत्सुभीमसेनेन सात्वतेन च रक्षितः॥
en: Partha soon made the earth deluged with blood. The mighty and indomitable son of Pritha of prowess incapable of being baffled, spreading a terrible carnage in that host of yours, soon reached the ruler of the Sindhus. Protected by Bhimasena and by Satvata, Vibhatsu.

sa: तथैव नकुलो धीमान् सहदेवश्च दुर्जयः। धृष्टद्युम्नः सहानीको विराटश्च सकेकयः॥
en: Similarly, Nakula endued with intelligence and Sahadeva difficult of being conquered and Dhrishtadyumna with his army and Virata together with the Kekayas.

sa: वितथांस्तान् समालक्ष्य पतितांश्च महीतले॥ क्षुरप्रेण सुतीक्ष्णेन कार्मुकं चिच्छिदे भृशम्।
en: Beholding those arrows thus sent back and scattered over the ground, he (Shikhandin) severed his dreadful bow with a sharp, razorhanded shaft.

sa: अनुतोक्तं प्रजां हन्यात् ततः पापमवाप्नुयाम्। तस्माद् धर्माभिरक्षार्थ नानृतं तक्तुमुत्सहे॥
en: False words will destroy creatures and the sin will come upon me. Therefore for preserving virtue I dare not speak an untruth.

sa: वृषसेनस्ततो राजन् दुपदं नवभिः शरैः। विद्ध्वा विव्याध सप्तत्या पुनरन्यैस्रिभित्रिभिः॥
en: Vrishasena them, o king, having pierced Drupada with nine arrows, pierced him again with seventy and once more with another three shafts.

sa: शिखराणि व्यशीर्यन्त गिरीणां तत्र भारत। अपसव्यं मृगाश्चैव पाण्डुसेनां प्रचक्रिरे॥
en: The crests of mountains, O Bharata, began 10 split up. Diverse animals then passed keeping the son of Pandu to their right.

sa: ततः शरसहस्राणि विमुञ्चन् विवभौ तदा। कर्णपुत्रो महाराज वर्षमाण इवाम्बुदः॥
en: Then, discharging thousands of arrows in that battle, the son of Karna, O mighty monarch, looked like cloud pouring torrents of rain.

sa: संछिन्ना नेमिभिश्चैव मृदिताश्च हयद्विपैः। क्रोशन्तस्तात पुत्रेति पलायन्ते परे भयात्॥
en: Some loudly calling their sires and their sons fled away in fear, without recognising one another and reduced in energy by grief.

sa: विनिःश्वसन्तस्ते राजन् भग्नदंष्ट्रा इवोरगाः। धिगहो धिग्गतः पार्थः कृष्णश्चेत्यब्रुवन् पृथक्॥
en: O king, beating like snakes whose fangs have been broken, they exclaimed, 'Fie fie on us; Oh, Partha and Krishna, have gone.'

sa: संजय उवाच भीमसेन सपाञ्चाल्यं चेदिकेकयसंवृतम्। वैकर्तनःस्वयं रुद्ध्वा वारयामास सायकैः॥
en: Sanjaya said After this Vaikartana, himself resisting Bhimasena aided by the king of Panchala, Chedi and Kaikeya, showered numberless arrows upon him.

sa: भल्लेनान्येन तु पुनः सुवर्णोज्ज्वलकुण्डलम्। निचकत शिरः कायाद् द्रुमसेनस्य वीर्यवान्॥
en: Dhristadyumna pierced him in return with three sharp straight-flying arrows, winged with golden feathers, whetted on stone and capable of destroying life.

sa: ततः कर्णो हतं मत्वा वृषसेनं महारथम्। पुत्रशोकाभिसंतप्तः सात्यकिं प्रत्यपीड्यत्॥
en: Pierced with the shaft of Satyaki, the highly effulgent and puissant Vrishasena fell down on his car, losing hold of his bow.

sa: सिंह केसरिणं क्रुद्धमतिक्रम्याभिनर्दसे। शृगाल इव मूढस्त्वं नृसिंह कर्ण पाण्डवम्॥
en: You are a fool to yell at Arjuna, the best of men, disregarding him like a jackal yelling at an excited lion.

sa: ततोभी: प्राविशत् काकं तदा तत्र विचेतसम्॥ द्वीपगुमानपश्यन्तं निपातार्थे श्रमान्वितम्।
en: Then the crow became afraid who was almost besides himself at not seeing any island or trees whereon to perch when tired.

sa: हंसांश्चावहसन्ति स्म प्रावदन्नप्रियाणि च॥ उत्पत्योत्पत्य च मुहुर्मुहूर्तमिति चेति च। वृक्षाग्रेभ्यः स्थलेभ्यश्च निपतन्त्युत्पतन्ति त॥ कुर्वाणा विविधान् रावानाशंसन्तो जयं तथा।
en: The swans also laughed aloud making many unpleasant remarks. They began to rise up and alight repeatedly. They came down and rose up from the tops of the trees and the surface of the earth; they began to emit cries bespeaking their respective victories.

sa: सच्छिन्नधन्वा विरतो हताश्वो हतसारथिः॥ खङ्गमादत्त विपुलं शतचन्द्रं च भानुमत्।
en: Having his bow and car broken and horses and charioteer slain, he took up a huge sword shining like a hundred moon.

sa: संजय उवाच भूरिश्रवसि संक्रान्ते परलोकाय भारत। वासुदेव महाबाहुरर्जुनः समचूचुदत्॥
en: Sanjaya said After Bhurisravas had gone to the regions of the departed, O Bharata, that mighty-armed Arjuna urged Vasudeva sayingचोदयाश्वान् भृशं कृष्ण

sa: पार्षतेन परासृष्टं ज्वलन्तमिव तद् धनुः। अन्तकालमनुप्राप्तं मेनिरे वीक्ष्य सैनिकाः॥
en: Beholding that resplendent bow bent by the son of Prisata, the soldiers considered that the last hour of the world had come.

sa: यद्येनं समतिक्रम्य प्रविष्टः श्वेतवाहनः। नात्र सूक्ष्मोऽपि दोषः स्यादाचार्यस्य कथंचन॥
en: If Shetavahana entered (into the array) after having overcome him the preceptor cannot be found fault with in the least (for that).

sa: मद्रकाः सिन्धुसौवीराः धर्म विद्युः कथं त्वित्॥ पापदेशोद्भवा म्लेच्छा धर्माणामविचक्षणाः।
en: The Madrakas and Sindhu Souviras are born in a sinful country, are Melechas and innocent of duties. How can they know them?

sa: ततो द्रौणिर्महाराज शरवर्षेण मारिष॥ छादयामास तत् सैन्यं समन्ताद् भरतर्षभ।
en: Then, O monarch, O great sire of the Bharata race, the son of Drona covered the Pandava army with showers of arrows.

sa: समाश्वस्ताः स्त्रियस्तास्तु वेपमाना मुहुर्मुहुः। कदल्य इव वातेन धूयमानाः समन्ततः॥
en: In spite of their being comforted (by Sanjaya), those ladies shivered every moment like the plantain tree constantly shaken by the wind.

sa: सायुधाः सगदाश्चैव सखगाः सपरश्वधाः। सप्रासकवचाश्चान्ये नराः सुप्ताः पृथक् पृथक्॥
en: Others soldiers, well-armed and with maces, swords, axes and lances in grasp and covered with coats of mail, laid themselves down separately.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्न: शिखण्डी च द्रौपदेयाः प्रभद्रकाः। सात्यकिश्चेकितानश्च द्राविडैः सैनिकैः सह।॥
en: So also Dhrishtadyumna, Shikhandin, the sons of Draupadi, the Provadrakas and Shatyaki and Chekitana accompanied by the Dravida warriors (proceeded against us);

sa: दर्शयन्तावुभौ शिक्षा लाघवं सौष्ठवं तथा। रणे रणकृतां श्रेष्ठावन्योन्यं पर्यकर्षताम्॥
en: And both displayed their training agility and skill. Those foremost of warriors in that battle, made many skillful thirst at each other.

sa: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय द्रुपदस्यात्मजो बली॥ तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति संक्रुद्धो हार्दिक्यं प्रत्यभाषत।
en: Taking up another bow, the most powerful son of Drupada, being greatly enraged, replied to the son of Hridika saying, Wait, Wait.

sa: एतदाज्ञाय वचनं सर्वोस्तानब्रवीत् तदा। जीवितं रक्षत नृपाः शासनं प्रतिगृह्यताम्॥
en: Hearing these words expressive of their submission, Dhananjaya said them, 'Do you, O kings, save your lives, to and accept my dominion.'

sa: तैः शिरोभिर्मही कीर्णा बाहुभिश्च सहाङ्गदैः। वभौ कनकपाषाणा भुजगैरिव संवृतां॥
en: Strewn over with their heads and arms decked with Angadas, the Earth appeared as if covered with golden stones and numerous snakes.

sa: ते वध्यमानाः समरे भीमचापच्युतैः शरैः। प्राद्रवंस्तावका योधाः किमेतदिति चाब्रुवन्॥
en: Wounded with the arrows shot from Bhima's bow, your troops then began to fly away from the field saying what is it?

sa: ततः प्रहस्य समरे भैमसेनिर्महाबलः॥ प्रादुश्चक्रे महामायां कर्णं प्रति महारथम्।
en: Then the highly puissant son of Bhimasena smiling the while invoked into existence an allpowerful illusion against that mighty carwarrior viz., Karna.

sa: धनत्यागः सुखत्यागो देशत्यागोऽपि वाऽनघ। वयस्यार्थे प्रवर्तन्ते स्नेहं दृष्ट्वा तथाविधम्॥
en: Witnessing such affection, people can, O sinless one, forsake wealth, comfort, and even their native land for the sake of their friends.

sa: एवमुक्तश्च कर्णेन शल्यो मद्राधिपस्तदा। हंसवर्णान् हयान्ग्रयान् प्रैषीद् यत्र वृकोदरकः॥
en: Thus accosted by Karna, the king of Madras urged those best of horses of the color of swans to where Vrikodara was.

sa: नान्यां गतिं गमिष्यामि नान्यच्छरणमस्ति मे। दैवं पुरुषकारेण निवर्तयितुमर्हसि ॥
en: Other way will I wend none; nor is there any other refuge for me. It behove you to meet Density with exertion.

sa: घोरा समभवत् संध्या दारुणा मृगपक्षिणः। अप्रकाशा दिशः सर्वा वातैरासन्ननार्तवैः॥
en: The twilight became fearfully bark and (the roars of) birds and beasts (grew) fiercer. All sides became invisible, (being covered with darkness).

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तथा तु दृष्ट्वा बहु तत्र देवीं रोरूयमाणां कुररीमिवार्ताम्। नोचुर्वचः साध्वथ वाप्यसाधु महीक्षितो धार्तराष्ट्रस्य भीताः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Through the kings present there saw the lady (Draupadi) crying piteously in affliction like a female osprey, yet they, out of the fear for the son of Dhritarashtra (Duryodhana), did not utter a word good or evil.

sa: धृत्या यया धारयते मनःप्राणेन्द्रियक्रियाः। योगेनाव्यभिचारिण्या धृतिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी॥
en: Sattva constancy, O Partha, is that by which through devotion one controls the function of the mind, the life-breaths and the senses.

sa: एतांस्तु वासुदेवोऽपि रथोदारान् प्रशंसति। सततं प्रियकामाश्च कर्णस्यैते वशे स्थिताः॥
en: Even Vasudeva's son praises these men as mighty car-warriors. Always solicitous of doing good to the Kurus, they are obedient to Karna.

sa: ततस्तद् राक्षसं सैन्यं घोरचर्मायुधध्वजम्। निर्जगाम जनस्थानान्माहानादं महाजवम्॥ मुद्वरैः पट्टिशैः शूलैः सुतीक्ष्णैश्च परश्वधैः। खङ्गैश्चक्रैश्च हस्तस्थैभ्राजमानैः सतोमरैः॥ शक्तिभिः परिधैोरैरतिमात्रैश्च कार्मुकैः। गदासिमुसलैर्वज्रगृहीतैर्भीमदर्शनैः॥ राक्षसानां सुघोराणां सहस्राणि चतुर्दश । निर्यातानि जनस्थानात् खरचित्तानुवर्तिनाम्॥
en: Then uttering tremendous roars, rushed out with great vehemence four and ten thousand of those terrible Rākşasas equipped with clubs and parțiśas and darts and sharpened axes, and scimitars and discuses, shining beautifully in their hands and saktis and dreadful parighas and innumerable bows, and maces, and musalas and vajras fearful to behold, griped fast. And those following the will of Khara issued out of Janasthāna.

sa: सांस्तु निर्धावतो दृष्ट्वा राक्षसान् भीमदर्शनान्। खरस्याथ रथः किंचिज्जगाम तदनन्तरम्॥
en: Seeing those Rākṣasas of dreadful forms rushing out, Khara's car remaining a little away (from the press), proceeded after a short space.

sa: भ्रातरं निहतं दृष्ट्वा शयानं निर्जितं रणे। शोकवेगपरीतात्मा विललाप विभीषणः॥
en: Beholding his brother defeated, slain and lying down on the battle-field, Vibhisana overpowered with the weight of his grief, began to lament.

sa: तदेवं निश्चयं दृष्ट्वा तत्त्वमास्थाय विज्वरः। यदिहानन्तरं कार्य कल्प्यं तदनुचिन्तय॥
en: Beholding this to be certain and attaining calmness, do you be freed from your sorrow an think what should be done now.

sa: तस्मान्मुक्तः वयं दाहादिमं वृक्षमुपाश्रिताः। कां दिशं प्रतिपत्स्यामः प्राप्ताः क्लेशमनुत्तमम्॥
en: Having escaped from that fire, we are now resting under this tree. Having suffering great afflictions, where are we now to go?

sa: शक्र उवाच भगवंस्त्वप्रसादेन दितिजं सुदुरासदम्। वज्रेण निहनिष्यामि पश्यतस्ते सुरर्षभ॥
en: Shakra said Before your eyes, O foremost of gods, I shall, through your favour kill with my thunderbolt this invincible son Diti.

sa: स कुम्भकर्णस्य शरान्शरीरे सप्त वीर्यवान्। निचखानाददे चान्यान्विससर्ज च लक्ष्मणः॥
en: Lakşamna endued with prowess shot seven shafts at Kumbhakarma's body; and next, taking up other arrows also discharged them (at his antagonist).

sa: अश्रद्धेयमिदं वाक्यं कथयन्ती न लजसे। विशेषतो मत्सकाशे दुष्टतापसि गम्यताम्॥
en: Your these words deserve no credence. Are you not ashamed to utter them, specially before me? Go away, O wicked ascetic woman.

sa: रथान् मण्डलचक्रांश्च योजयित्वा परः शतम्। उष्ट्रगोऽश्वखरै त्या भरतं यान्तमन्वयुः॥
en: Thereat servants by means of an hundred cars, furnished with circular wheels, and yoked with camels, oxen, horses, and asses, followed Bharata.

sa: ततो रुद्धे शकृन्मूत्रे सैन्यमानाह दुःखितम्।। तथागतमभिप्रेक्ष्य पर्यपृच्छत् स पार्थिवः॥ तपोनित्यस्य वृद्धस्य रोषणस्य विशेषतः। केनापकृतमद्येह भार्गवस्य महात्मनः॥
en: Their state thus becoming deplorable, they were greatly afflicted. Seeing this the king asked, "Who has done injury to the illustrious son of Bhrigu, who is old, who is ever engaged in asceticism and who is of wrathful temper?

sa: तेषां तत्समवेतानां वाक्यं धर्मार्थसंहितम्। श्रुत्वा परिषदो मध्ये रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्॥
en: All other ministers and priests agreed with Vasistha's words. There upon hearing their moral counsels, Rama said to Lakşmaņa before the assembly.

sa: पतितैः पतमानैश्च पादपस्थैश्च मारुतः। कुसुमैः पश्य सौमित्रे क्रीडतीव समन्ततः॥
en: Behold, O Saumitri, the wind is sporting at all sides as it were with flowers drops, dropping and hanging on the trees.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच धृतराष्ट्राभ्यनुज्ञातास्ततस्ते कुरुपाण्डवाः। अभ्ययुर्धातरः सर्वे गान्धारी सह केशवाः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Ordered by Dhritarashtra, those foremost of Kuru's race, viz., the Pandava brothers, accompanied by Keshava, then went to see Gandhari.

sa: सौमित्रे पश्य पम्पाया दक्षिणे गिरिसानुषु। पुष्पितां कर्णिकारस्य यष्टिं परमशोभिताम्॥
en: Behold O Lakşmaņa, the flowery branches of the Karņikāras on the summits of the mountain situated on the southern bank of Pampā.

sa: इह रामः प्रभाते श्वो भवितेति मतिर्मम। द्रष्टास्येनमिहायान्तं तवं दर्शनकाझ्या॥
en: I think Rama will be here on the morrow. You will see him come here owing to your desire for seeing him.

sa: एकोदरकृते व्याघ्रः करोति विघसं बहु। तमन्येऽप्युपजीवन्ति मन्दा लोभवशा मृगाः॥
en: The tiger, for filling one stomach of his, kills many animals. Other weak animals moved by covetousness live upon the tiger's prey.

sa: एष च भ्रातृभिः सार्धं सुशर्माऽऽह्वयते रणे। वधाय सगणस्यास्य मामनुज्ञातुमर्हसि॥
en: This Susarman with his brothers is summoning me to battle. It behoves you to permit me to slay him and his followers.

sa: त्रिविधं नरकस्येदं द्वारं नाशनमात्मनः। काम: क्रोधस्तथा लोभस्तस्मादेतत् त्रयं त्यजेत्॥
en: Threefold is the way to hell, ever ruinous to self, namely, lust, and avarice. Therefore, one should, above all, renounces these three.

sa: आयुधानि च मुख्यानि नागराः शकटानि च। अनुगच्छन्तु काकुत्स्थं व्याधाश्चारण्यकोविदाः॥
en: Let the foremost weapons, and the citizens, and cars, and fowlers well acquainted with the forest go in the wake of Käkutstha.

sa: यजन् पुण्येषु देशेषु विसृजेश्चाप्तदक्षिणाः। ऋषिभिश्चापि संगम्य प्रवत्स्यति सुखं वने॥
en: Performing sacrifices at holy spots, and dispensing the prescribed Dakşiņās, let Rāma happily reside in the forest in the company of saints.

sa: अत्यद्भुतमिदं वाक्यं तव राम शुभाक्षरम्। पावनः सर्वभूतानां त्वमेव रघुनन्दन॥
en: O Rāma these words, set in charming letters, are highly wonderful. O descendant of Raghu, you are the purifier of all creatures.

sa: ततः प्रभाते विमले कृतकर्मा नराधिपः। विश्वामित्रं महात्मानमाजुहाव सराघवम्॥ तमर्चयित्वा धर्मात्मा शास्त्रदृष्टेन कर्मणा। राघवौ च महात्मानौ तदा वाक्यमुवाच ह॥
en: The next morning, which happened to be bright, the lord of men, having performed his daily devotions, welcomed Viśvāmitra and Rāghava. And having, in accordance with the scriptures, paid homage to the former as well as the two high-souled Rāghavas, that virtuous one said,

sa: तेषां जिज्ञासमानानां शैवं धनुरूपाहृतम्॥ न शेकुर्ग्रहणे तस्य धनुषस्तोलनेऽपि वा।
en: And on their being curious (as to the bow), I showed it to them; but they could neither hold nor wield it.

sa: एवं बहुविधा विप्राः पुराणा यज्ञवाहनाः। विद्यवृद्धाः शुचयो वृत्तवन्तो यशस्विनः॥
en: Many Brahmanas of this kind in days of yore, devoted to the celebration of Vedas, endued with purity, good conduct and fame.

sa: इदं योजनपर्यन्तं सरः सुरुचिरप्रभम्। अरजे विज्वरा भुझ्व कालश्चात्र प्रतीक्ष्यताम्॥
en: Without any anxiety O Arajās, do you wait for the time at the picturesque banks of this pond extending over a Yojana.

sa: राजन्नदृश्यतैकस्थो राजस्तस्य महामखे। जत्र जातिसहस्राणि पुरुषाणां ततस्ततः॥ गृहीत्वा भाजनान् जग्मुर्बहूनि भरतर्षभ। स्रग्विणश्चापि ते सर्वे सुमृष्टमाणकुण्डला:॥ पर्यवेषन द्विजातीस्ताशतशोऽथ सहस्रशः।
en: Thousands of nations and races were there. A large number of men. O chief of Bharata's race, adorned with garlands and wearing bright ear-rings made of gold, taking numberless vessels in their hands, distributed the food to the twice-born classes by hundreds and thousands.

sa: राजन्नदृश्यतैकस्थो राजस्तस्य महामखे। जत्र जातिसहस्राणि पुरुषाणां ततस्ततः॥ गृहीत्वा भाजनान् जग्मुर्बहूनि भरतर्षभ। स्रग्विणश्चापि ते सर्वे सुमृष्टमाणकुण्डला:॥ पर्यवेषन द्विजातीस्ताशतशोऽथ सहस्रशः।
en: Thousands of nations and races were there. A large number of men. O chief of Bharata's race, adorned with garlands and wearing bright ear-rings made of gold, taking numberless vessels in their hands, distributed the food to the twice-born classes by hundreds and thousands.

sa: आयाति भीमसेनासौ सहाश्वेन तवानुजः। यथा मे पुरुषाः प्राहुर्ये धनंजयसारिणः॥
en: Your younger brother (Arjuna), O Bhimasena, is returning with the horse. I have learnt this from those men who had followed Arjuna.

sa: गजाश्च बहुला राजन् नराश्च जयगृद्धिनः॥ रथे स्थिताश्च राजेन्द्र परिवब्रुर्वृकोदरम्।
en: Hosts of elephants, O monarch and men, eager for victory, as also war-chariots and horses, O King of Kings, thickened around Vrikodara.

sa: आसीद् बुद्धिर्हते कर्णे तव योधस्य कस्यचित्। वणिजो नावि भिन्नायामगाधे विप्लवा इव॥ अपारे पारमिच्छन्तो हते द्वीपे किरीटिना।
en: They then looked like ship-wrecked merchants on the vast sea without a raft to save themselves. When their protector was slain by the diadem-decked Arjuna, they were like persons on the vast sea desirous of reaching safely some shore.

sa: तेषां शराणां वेगेन शितानां तिग्मतेजसाम्। विमुह्यमानो राधेयो यत्नात् तमनुधावति॥
en: The son of Radha (Karna), being much pestered by his swift, powerful and effulgent arrows, attacked Arjuna with more care (than before).

sa: उत्क्षिप्य च भुजौ काचिद्भूमौ सुपरिवर्तते। हतस्य वदनं दृष्ट्वा काचिन्मोहमुपागमत्॥
en: And some taking up his hand rolled on the ground and some were beside themselves (with grief) beholding the slain (Ravana's) countenance.

sa: हीनबुद्धिगुणो बाला हीनस्थानेन चाप्यहम्। भवता च विनाभूतो न वर्तयितुमुत्सहे॥
en: Void of sense and quality, a body, and inferior to you in point of years, I, deprived of you, can not live.

sa: सुवर्णनासां यः कृत्वा सुखुरां कृष्णधेनुकाम्। तिलैः प्रच्छादितां दद्यात् सर्वरत्नैरलंकृताम्॥
en: The person who donets a black cow duly ornamented with jwels including nose-ring made of gold and the hoof made of silver.

sa: मृदन्तस्ते नरान् राजन् हयांश्च सुबहून् रणे। वातायमाना दृश्यन्ते गन्धर्वनगरोपमाः॥
en: Crushing, O king, innumerable men and steeds in that battle, those cars of the velocity of wind appeared beautiful like aerial castles.

sa: तेन विद्धा महेष्वासा भीष्मेणामित्रकर्षिणा। चुक्रुधुः समरे राजन् पादस्पृष्टा इवोरगाः॥
en: Then those pierced by Bhishma that girder of foes, waxed worth, O king, in battle like a snake trampled under the feet.

sa: तौ मुहूर्तं समाश्वस्य पुनरेव परंतपौ। अभ्यहारयतान्योन्यं सम्प्रगृह्य गदे शुभे॥
en: Having rested for sometime those two destroyers of foes, taking up their handsome maces, once again began to prevent each other's attacks.

sa: तेनार्दिता महाराज रथिनः सादिनस्तथा। निपेतुरुवा॒ सहसा वातभग्ना इव द्रुमाः॥
en: O monarch, pierced by him car-warriors and cavalry began to fall down suddenly on the ground, like trees broken by the hurricane.

sa: तस्य दीप्ता महाबाणा विनिश्चेरुः सहस्रशः। भानोरिव महाराज धर्मकाले मरीचयः॥
en: Like the rays of the sun, o king, mighty arrows of blazing effulgence shot by him, began to fly (on all sides).

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच पाण्डुरुत्थाय सहसा गन्तुकामो महर्षिभिः। स्वर्गपारं तितीर्घः स शतशृङ्गादुदङ्मुखः॥ प्रतस्थे सह पत्नीभ्यामब्रुवंस्तं च तापसाः। उपर्युपरि गच्छन्तः शैलराजमुदङ्मुखाः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Pandu suddenly rose with the desire of going with the Rishis and reaching the heaven. When he was about to start with his two wives in a northerly direction from the mountains with the hundred peaks, the ascetics addressed him thus.

sa: तमभ्यधावत् कौन्तेयः प्रगृह्य सशरं धनुः॥ भीमसेनो महाबाहुस्तिष्ठ निष्ठेति चाब्रवीत्।
en: Taking up his bow with arrows on it, the mighty-armed Bhimasena, the son of Kunti, rushed towards Ashvatthaman, and said, 'Wait, wait!'

sa: क्षत्रियस्यातिवृत्तस्य ब्राह्मणेषु विशेषतः। ब्रह्मैव संनियन्तृ स्यात् क्षत्रं हि ब्रह्मसम्भवम्॥
en: If the Kshatriya misbehaves himself, especially towards Brahmanas, the Vedas themselves will put them down. The Kshatriyas have originated from the Brahmanas.

sa: द्रोणस्तु पञ्चभिर्बाणैर्वासुदेवमताडयत्। अर्जुनं च त्रिसप्तत्या ध्वजं चास्य त्रिभिः शरैः॥
en: Then Drona with five arrows afflicted the son of Vasudeva and he struck Vibhatsu with seventy-three shafts and his standard with three.

sa: एकादश च यान्याहुरिन्द्रियाणि विशेषतः। अहंकारात् प्रसूतानि तानि वक्ष्याम्यहं द्विजाः॥
en: I shall now, O twice-born ones, mention particularly, those which have been called the eleven organs and which have originated from Egoism.

sa: तस्य तां शीघ्रतामीक्ष्य तुतोषातीव वीर्यवान्। गुडाकेशो महातेजा बालस्य धृतवर्मणः॥
en: Seeing that lightness of hand shown by the youth Dhritavarman, Gudakesha of great energy and great prowess became highly pleased with him.

sa: तमूचुः पुरुषव्याघ्रं संशप्तकनिषूदनम्। तवास्म किंकराः सर्वे सर्वे वै वशगास्तव॥
en: They then addressed that foremost of men, that destroyer of the Samsaptaka army, saying, 'We are your slaves! We yield to you.

sa: अभिगम्य सुदुर्धर्षः सहदेवो युधां पतिः। विकृष्य बलवच्चापं क्रोधेन प्रज्वलन्निव॥
en: Approaching his enemy, the invincible Sahadeva, that best of warriors, forcibly drawing his bow and as if consuming his enemy with anger.

sa: स तीव्रगन्धसंतप्तो देवदूतमुवाच ह। गम्यतां तत्र येषां त्वं दूतस्तेषामुपान्तिकम्॥
en: Afflicted by the very foul smell, he addressed the celestial messenger, saying, Return to the presence of those whose messenger you are.

sa: तथोपविष्टेषु महारथेषु विराजमानाभरणाम्बरेषु। रराज सा राजवती समृद्धा ग्रहैरिव द्यौर्विमलैरुपेता॥
en: Those mighty heroes, shining in ornaments and clothes, being seated, that assemblage of kings shone like the firmament studded with beautiful stars.

sa: भीमसेनोऽपि मांसानि भक्ष्याणि विविधानि च। अतिसृष्टानि मत्स्येन विक्रीणीते युधिष्ठिरे॥
en: Bhimsena also sold to Yudhishthira, the meat and the viands of various sorts which were given by the king of the Matsyas.

sa: सा चिन्तयन्ती च यदा नान्नहेतुमविन्दत॥ मनसा चिन्तयामास कृष्णं कंसनिषूदनम्।
en: While she was thus thinking she could not find any means. She then thought in mind of Krishna, the slayer at Kansa.

sa: महिषानप्यतिबलो बलिनो विचकर्ष ह। सिंहानां च सुदृप्तानां शतान्याकर्षयद् बलात्॥
en: Endued with great strength he used to drag down the mightiest of buffaloes. Through his prowess, he tamed hundreds of ferocious lions.

sa: सांख्यज्ञानमधीयानो योगशास्त्रं च कृत्स्नशः। धर्माधर्मं च राजेन्द्र प्राकृतं परिगर्हयन्॥
en: Taking no notice of all ordinary duties, the king began to study the science of the Sankhyas and the Yogins in full.

sa: ततः क्रुद्धस्त्रिभिर्बाणैभीमसेनं हसन्निव। अभिहत्य दृढं युद्धे तान् सर्वान् प्रत्यविध्यत॥
en: Thereafter Kritavarman inflamed with rage, smilingly striking Bhimasena with three arrows, began, in return, to pierce the other warriors (with his arrows).

sa: ततो द्रोणः सत्यसंधः प्रभिन्न इव कुञ्जरः। अभ्यतीत्य स्थानीकं दृढसेनमपातयत्॥
en: Then Drona of never-failing aim and resembling an elephant with rent temples, passing over the car host of the Pandavas felled Dhirasena

sa: यस्य प्रसादात् कुर्वन्ति कर्माणि पुरुषर्षभाः। अमानुषाणि संग्रामे देवैरसुकराणि च॥
en: That Drona son of mighty sage, who had been insulted by the low-minded, cruel and mcan Dhristadyumna the slayer of his preceptor.

sa: मतङ्ग उवाच अन्यं वरं वृणीष्व त्वं दुर्लभोऽयं हि ते वरः। किं मां तुदसि दुःखार्तं मृतं मारयसे च माम्॥
en: Matanga said Stricken as I am with grief, why, O Shakra, do you afflict me further? You are striking one that is already dead, by this conduct. I do not pity you who having acquired the dignity of a Brahmana fail to retain it.

sa: मन्यते छिन्नबाहुं मां भूरिश्रवसमाहवे॥ उत्सृजैनमहं चैनमेष वा मां हनिष्यति।
en: He takes me for Bhurisravas with his arm lopped off. Leave him, Either I will slay him or he shall slay me

sa: यदि चाहमनुग्राह्यो भवतो दयितोऽपि वा। क्रियतां तावदाहारस्ततो वेत्स्याम्यहं परम्॥
en: If I deserve your favour, if I am dear to you, do you eat something. I shall then know what to do.

sa: स मां त्वं यदि राजेन्द्र परित्यज्य गमिष्यसि। पृष्ठतस्त्वनुयास्यामि सत्यमात्मानमालभे॥
en: If you, O king of kings, go to the forest leaving me, I shall then follow you. I swear by iny soul.

sa: अहं वनं गमिष्यामि प्रशासतु। न मामयशसा दग्धं भूयस्त्वं दग्धुमर्हसि॥
en: I shall go into the forest. Do you rule the kingdom You should not burn me who am already burned by infamy.

sa: ताः शनैरिव सव्रीडं प्रशशंसुर्युधिष्ठिरम्। भीमसेनार्जुनौ चैव माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ॥
en: With soft and modest voices they described the praises of Yudhishthira, of Bhima and Arjuna, and of the two sons of Madri.

sa: स राजमार्गः शुशुभे समलंकृतचत्वरः। यथा चन्द्रोदये राजन् वर्धमानो महोदधिः॥
en: The well adorned squares and streets, with the crowd of men, shone like the ocean rising at the rise of the moon.

sa: एष ते निशितैर्बाणैर्दप॑ हन्मि स्थिरो भव। सधनुष्मान् महाकायस्ततो मामभ्यभाषत॥
en: Stay (awhile), I will destroy your pride with these sharpened arrows." Then that hugebodied being taking up his bow rushed against me.

sa: पुनस्तानि शरीराणि एकीभूतानि भारत। अदृश्यन्त महाराज तान्यहं व्यधमं पुनः॥
en: Again, O Bharata, O great king, seeing that all his bodies became merged into one, 1 struck at it a second time.
