sa: वर्तमानेषु धर्मेण पाण्डवेषु महात्मसु। व्यवर्धन् कुरवः सर्वे हीनदोषा: सुखान्विताः॥
en: In consequence of the illustrious Pandavas being virtuous, all the Kurus, being free from sin and becoming very happy, grew in prosperity.

sa: ततः शुश्राव राजा स राक्षसेभ्यो महाभयम्॥ निर्ययौ नगराचापि चतुरङ्गबलान्वितः।
en: The king then heard of the fear of Rakshasa in his kingdom. With his fourfold forces, he went out of his capital.

sa: जाम्बूनदविचित्रं च वर्म निर्भिद्य भानुमत्। अभ्यगाद धरणीमुनो रुधिरेण समुक्षितः॥
en: Then that fierce arrow, penetrating through the effulgent and gold-decked armour of Kritavarman, fell down on the ground, steeped completely in blood.

sa: व्यसृजत् तं महाज्वालं संक्रुद्धमिव पन्नगम्। सोऽविध्यत् कृतवर्माणं यमदण्डोपमः शरः॥
en: That emitted great effulgence and looked like an enraged snake; that arrow that resembled the the dart of Death, wounded Kritavarman sorely.

sa: समकम्पत दुर्घर्षः क्षितिकम्पे यथाचलः। त्रिषष्ट्या चतुरोऽस्याश्वान् सप्तभिः सारथिं तथा॥ विव्याध निशितैस्तूर्णं सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः। सुवर्णपुङ्ख विशिखं समाधाय च सात्यकिः॥
en: Began to tremble like a mountain during an earth-quake. Then Stayaki of prowess incapable of being baffled quickly pierced his four steeds with sixty-three and his charioteer with seven sharp arrows. Then Satyaki placed on his bow string a shaft furnished with golden wings.

sa: राजसूये ऋतुश्रेष्ठे निवृत्ते जनमेजय। जायते सुमहाघोर: संग्रामः क्षत्रियान् प्रति॥
en: After the termination of that foremost of sacrifices, viz., the Rajasuya (of Varuna), a terrible battle, O Janamejaya, ensued amongst the Kshatriyas.

sa: शूद्राः परिचरिष्यन्ति न द्विजान् युगसंक्षये। आश्रमेषु महर्षीणां ब्राह्मणावसथेषु च॥
en: At this age, the Shudras will cease to serve the Brahmanas. In the hermitages of the Brahmanas, in their schools and colleges,

sa: लोमश उवाच अद्रिराजं महाशैलं मेरुं कनकपर्वतम्। उदयास्तमने भानुः प्रदक्षिणमवर्तत॥
en: Lomasha said : The sun between his rising and setting went round that king of mountains, that great golden mountain named Meru.

sa: कौरवं पञ्चविंशत्या क्षुद्रकाणां समार्पयत्। दुर्योधनस्तु संक्रुद्धो भीमसेनस्य मारिष॥ क्षुरप्रेण धनुश्छित्त्वा दशभिः प्रत्यविध्यत। अथान्यद् धनुरादाय भीमसेनो महाबलः॥
en: Oppressed him with five and twenty short arrows. Duryodhana also, O worshipfui sire, inflamed with ire, cut-off his bow with razorshaped dart and then pierced him in return with ten (darts). Thereupon, the highly-powerful Bhimasena, taking up another bow.

sa: अभिभूतः स रामेण संयुक्तः कालधर्मणा। अर्जुनस्याथ दायादा रामेण कृतमन्यवः॥
en: Being under the shadow of death, he was overpowered by Rama. Then the relatives of Arjuna, with their wrath excited against Rama.

sa: एवमुक्तोऽर्जुनो राज्ञा प्राञ्जलिर्नुपमब्रवीत्। यथा भवानाह तथा तत् सर्वेन तदन्यथा।॥
en: Thus accosted by the king, Arjuna replied with joined hands “Every thing will be done as you say. Nothing will be otherwise."

sa: पश्य कर्ण महाघोरं भयदं लोमहर्षणम्॥ कबन्धं मेघसंकाशं भानुमावृत्य संस्थितम्।
en: Behold, O Arjuna, the dreadful and evil Ketu of vapoury form, capable of making hairs erect. It has appeared covering the sun.

sa: अथ सात्यकिरागत्य कर्ण विद्ध्वाशितैः शरैः। नवत्या नवभिश्चोग्रैः शतेन पुनरार्पयत्॥
en: Thereupon Satyaki, having advanced to him, pierced Karna with ninety-nine sharpheaded and dreadful arrows and again, struck him with one hundred others.

sa: सदस्यं यमुपासीनं परस्य प्रियवादिनम्। दृष्ट्वा युधिष्ठिरं कोपो वर्धते मामसंशयम्॥
en: Beholding Yudhishthira as a courtier sitting beside another and uttering eulogistic speeches, who is there that is not positively afflicted with grief.

sa: यानीह रमणीयानि वनान्युपवनानि च। सर्वाणि तानि दृष्टानि पुनः पुनररिंदम॥
en: O chastiser of foes, we have seen again and again all the beautiful woods and forests in this part of the country.

sa: निर्भर्त्सनापवादैश्च ततैवाप्रियया गिरा। ब्राह्मणस्य पृथा राजन् न चकाराप्रियं तदा॥
en: Even if the Brahmana reproved, found fault with and spoke harsh words, to her, Pritha did not do anything disagreeable to him.

sa: गृहीत्वा प्रेक्षमाणा सा भर्तुः करविभूषितम्। भर्तारमिव सम्प्राप्त जानकी मुदिताभवत्॥
en: Taking the ring that used to deck her lord's finger and looking at it, Jānaki seemed to have actually got her lord.

sa: एवमुक्ता तु कैकेयी राघवेण महात्मना। उवाचेदं सुनिर्लज्जा धृष्टमात्महितं वचः॥
en: Being thus addressed by the high-souled Rāghava, that exceedingly shameless Kaikeyī spoke to him the following impudent words, fraught with her self-interest.

sa: अपि रामसहस्राणि भीतः पश्यामि रावण। रामभूतमिदं सर्वमरण्यं प्रतिभाति मे॥
en: Terrified as I am I always see thousands of Rāma around me. Me seems the entire forest is inhabited by Rāma only.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तस्मिनं वाक्यान्तरे वाक्यं क्षत्तापि विदुरोऽब्रवीत्। दुर्योधनमभिप्रेक्ष्य धार्तराष्ट्रममर्षणम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said At the end of that speech did Kshattri Vidura also speak words looking at the wrathful son of Dhritarashtra, Duryodhana.

sa: अपूपैश्चैव पूपैश्च मोदकैश्च समन्वितम्। सभापर्वणि राजेन्द्र हविष्यं भोजयेद् द्विजान्॥
en: When the Sabha Parva is being recited, Brahinanas should be fied with Havishıya along with Apupas and Pupas and Modakas, O king.

sa: स विह्वलितसर्वाङ्गः प्रचचाल रथोत्तमे। भूमिकम्पे यथा वृक्षश्चचाल कम्पितो भृशम्॥
en: All his limbs were weakened and he shook on that best of cars as a tree trembles greatly during an earth quake.

sa: तां समासाद्य देवस्तु विवस्वानिदमब्रवीत्। अयमस्म्यसितापाङ्गि ब्रूहि किं करवाणि ते॥
en: The deity Vivasvan (Sun), coming to her said, “O black-eyed lady, here I am. Tell me what I can do for you."

sa: कुरु प्रणामं धर्मात्मस्तेषामुद्दिश्य राघव। लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा प्रयतः संहताञ्जलिः॥
en: Do you, O Rāghava, O virtuous-souled one, make obeisance to them along with your brother Lakṣmaṇa, with concentrated heart and folded palms.

sa: धन्याः खलु महात्मानो ये बुद्ध्या कोपमुत्थितम्। निरुन्धन्ति महात्मानो दीप्तमग्निमिवाम्भसा॥
en: Blessed are those high-souled ones who control their wrath by dint of their own good sense, like to fire quenched by water.

sa: गृहमानापचारं सा बन्धुपक्षभयात्तदा। उत्ससर्ज कुमारं तं जले कुन्ती महाबलम्॥
en: She resolved to conceal her frailty from the fear of her friends and relatives. Kunti threw her that powerful son into water.

sa: सात्यकि दशभिविद्ध्वा हयांश्चास्य त्रिभिः शरैः॥७४ चापमेकेन चिच्छेद हार्दिक्यो नतपर्वणा।
en: Piercing Satyaki with ten arrows and his horses with three, the son of Hridika cut off his bow with a straight arrow.

sa: मानुषान गणे देव स्वल्पास्ते मम संमताः। दीर्घमायुश्च में प्राप्तं ब्रह्मणस्त्रिपुरान्तक। वाञ्छितं चायुषः शेषं शस्त्रं त्वं च प्रयच्छ मे॥
en: Man count I not ogod: They, I deem, are insignificant. I have also, O destroyer of Tripura, received a long lease of life from Brahmä. Now I wish to pass the remainder of my days in peace: and do you grant me a weapon.

sa: दुर्दर्शाः केचिदाभान्ति नरा: काष्ठमया इव। प्रियदर्शास्तथा चान्ये दर्शनादेव मानवाः॥
en: Some have such repulsive features as if they are made of wood, while others look very handsome at even the first sight.

sa: एवं संदिश्य तां वाणी देवानां चामृतोपमाम्। जगाम विष्णुर्देवेशः स्तूयमानस्त्रिविष्टपम्॥
en: Having addressed these nectar-like words to the deities and being glorified by them, Visnu, the god of gods, returned to his abode.

sa: तं तथा समरे राजन् विचरन्तमभीतवत्। पाण्डवा भृशसंविग्नाः प्रापश्यंस्तस्य विक्रमम्॥
en: 0 monarch, seeing him careering dauntlessly on the field of battle and beholding his prowess, the Pandava became filled with anxious thought.

sa: कर्णी त्वक् चक्षुषी जिह्वार नासिका चैव पञ्चमी। दर्शनीयेन्द्रियोक्तानि द्वाराण्याहारसिद्धये॥
en: The ears, skin, eyes, tongue, and nose forming the fifth, are the senses of knowledge. These exist for apprehending their respective objects.

sa: तस्याभिपतमानस्य दूषणस्य च राघवः। द्वाभ्यां शराभ्यां चिच्छेद सहस्ताभरणौ भुजौ॥
en: And as Dūsuņa was rushing forward, Rāghava by means of a couple of shafts cut off his two arms with the ornaments.

sa: एतत्प्रजानां श्रुत्वा तु प्रजानाथः प्रजापतिः॥ कारणादिति चोक्त्वासौ प्रजाः पुनरभाषत।
en: Hearing those words of the created beings, and saying the reason of that the lord of creation (the Patriarch Brahma) again said.

sa: तेऽब्रुवन् सहिताः सर्वे वृणीष्वान्यतमं शुभे। अस्माकमीप्सितं भद्रं पतित्वे वरवर्णिनि॥
en: They then all said to her “O blessed lady, O fortunate one, O beautiful damsel, chose one of us as your husband.

sa: तेषु भूतानि युज्यन्ते महाभूतेषु पञ्चसु। ते शब्दस्पर्शरूपेषु रसगन्धक्रियासु च॥
en: In these five great elements, in the matter of the operations of sound, touch, colour, taste, and smell, all creatures become deluded.

sa: श्रावस्तीति पुरी रम्या श्राविता च लवस्य ह। अयोध्या विजनां कृत्वा राघवो भरतस्तथा॥ स्वर्गस्य समनोद्योगं कृतवन्तौ महारथौ।
en: The city of Śrāvasti has been reared for Lava, and the mighty car-warriors Rama and Bharata, making Ayodhyā void of men, have addressed themselves for repairing to heaven. Having speedily communicated to him this intelligence the emissaries took rest.

sa: श्रीकुझं च सरस्वत्यास्तीर्थं भरतसत्तम। तत्र स्नात्वा नरश्रेष्ठ अग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत्॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, bathing in the Tirtha called Srikunja in the Sarasvati, one obtains the fruits of Agnishtoma sacrifice.

sa: अश्मवर्षं विमुञ्चन्ती भैरवं विचचार सा। ततस्तावश्मवर्षेण कीर्यमाणौ समन्ततः॥ दृष्ट्वा गाधिसुतः श्रीमानिदं वचनमब्रवीत्। अलं ते घृणया राम पापैषा दुष्ट्वारिणी॥ यज्ञविघ्नकरी यक्षी पुरा वर्धेत मायया। वध्यतां तावदेवैषा पुरा संध्या प्रवर्तते॥ रक्षांसि संध्याकाले तु दुर्धर्षाणि भवन्ति हि।
en: Terribly ranging the field, the Yakṣī showered crags upon her antagonists. And beholding them enveloped on all sides by that craggy downpour, the auspicious son of Gadhi spoke these words-O Rāma, renounce your antipathy. This one of wicked ways is exceedingly impious. And this sacrifice-disturbing Yakși will, by virtue of her power of illusion, come to increase more and more in energy. Do you, therefore, against the arrival of dusk, slay her! The Rākṣasas are incapable of being controlled when evening sets in.

sa: एकरात्रं समासाद्य एकरात्रोषितो नरः॥ नियतः सत्यवादी च ब्रह्मलोके महीयते।
en: Going to Ikaratra, he who lives there for one night with regulated vows and truthfulness, becomes adored in the region of Brahma.

sa: तस्यैवं ब्रुवतोऽमात्यास्तथेत्युक्त्वा समाहिताः। न्यवेशयंस्तांश्छन्देन स्वेन स्वेन पृथक् पृथक् ॥
en: When he had said this, the courtiers with collected minds saying, “Be it so,” disposed their forces, each according to his wish.

sa: कार्तवीर्यार्जुनो नाम राजा बाहुसहस्रवान्। येन सागरपर्यन्ता धनुषा निर्जिता मही॥
en: There was a king named Kartavirya-Arjuna who had a thousand arms. He conquered, with his bow, the Earth extending to the ocean.

sa: भीमसेनोऽपि समरे सम्प्राप्य स्वरथं पुनः। समारुह्य महाबाहुर्ययौ येन तवात्मजः॥
en: The mighty-armed Bhimasena also approaching his chariot mounted on it, and proceeded to that pare of the filed where your sons were.

sa: वाजिमुख्या मनुष्याश्च मत्ताश्च वरवारणाः। प्रच्छाद्य भगवन् भूमिं महतीमनुयान्ति माम्॥
en: Choice steeds, men, and mad elephants of the best kind, covering a spacious tract of country, come in my train, respected Sir.

sa: सत्त्वं बलमतः शीघ्रमादाय परिगृह्य च। विजयायाभिनियहि यत्र सर्वे वनौकसः॥
en: Therefore do you from this place, speedily taking this force, march to where the monkeys are, for securing victory (in the encounter).

sa: यमेवाधातुमिच्छन्ति तापसाः सततं वने। तस्यासौ दृश्यते धूमः संकुलः कृष्णवर्त्मनः॥
en: Here is seen the dense and dark smoke of that which the anchorets are ever anxious to preserve in the forest, fire.

sa: एवमुक्तो जगामेन्द्रो निर्विशङ्कस्त्रिविष्टपम्। विनता चापि सिद्धार्था बभूव मुदिता तथा॥
en: Having been thus addressed Indra, his fear being dispelled, went to heaven; and Vinata was much pleased, because her desire was accomplished.

sa: भेदे विनाशो राज्यस्य तत् पुत्र परिवर्जय। पित्रा मात्रा च पुत्रस्य यद् वै कार्यं परं स्मृतम्॥ प्राप्तस्त्वमसि तन्नाम पितृपैतामहं पदम्। अधीतवान् कृती शास्त्रे लालितः सततं गृहे॥
en: Dissension causes ruin to a kingdom. O son, therefore, abandon (the idea of gambling). O son, you have obtained all that is hard to be obtained from the father and the mother. You have obtained the rank and the possessions of your ancestors, you are taught, you are made learned in the Shastras, you were carefully brought up in the house.

sa: निवेशयत् मे सैन्यमभिप्रायेण सर्वतः। विश्रान्ताः प्रतरिष्यामः श्व इमां सागरणमाम्॥
en: Do you communicating to all our intentions, encamp the army. Having been fatigued, we shall cross the ocean-going Gangā on the morrow.

sa: न शोको न जरा तस्यां क्षुत्पिपासे न चाप्रियम्। न च दैन्यं क्लमो वापि प्रतिकूलं न चाप्युत।।४।
en: There is no grief, and no decrepitude, no hunger, no thirst; nor there was any thing disagreeable, nor there was any kind of wretchedness of distress. There can be no fatigue or any kind of evil-feelings in that Sabha.

sa: नागो नागमभिद्रुत्य रथी च रथिनं रणे। शक्तितोमरनाराचैर्निजने तत्र भारत॥
en: Elephant-warrior rushing against elephantwarrior and car-warrior against car-warrior, in that battle, killed each other with darts and lances and Narachas, O Bharata.

sa: तत्रैव प्रतितिष्ठन्ति पुनस्तत्रोपयन्ति च। सप्त सप्तर्षयः सिद्धा वसिष्ठप्रमुखैः सह॥
en: In that itself live, and from that emerge, the seven Rishis who are crowned with ascetic success, having Vasishtha for their foremost.

sa: धारयामि च चीराणि शाणक्षौमाजिनानि च। महार्हाणि च वासांसि धारयाम्यहमेकदा॥
en: Sometimes I am clad in rages, sometimes in sackcloth, sometimes in raiments of fine texture, sometimes in deer-skins, sometimes in richest robes.

sa: राघवेण तु वीरेण भयमुत्सृज्य दूरतः। त्वत्प्रियार्थं हतो वाली शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमः॥ सर्वथा प्रणयात् क्रुद्धो राघवो नात्र संशयः। भ्रातरं सम्प्रहीतवाँल्लक्ष्मणं लक्ष्मिवर्धनम्॥
en: To encompass your well-being, Vali, powerful as the Lord of celestials, was fearlessly destroyed by the heroic Rāghava. There is not the least doubt, that Rāghava, out of love, is enraged with you, and has despatched his younger brother Lakşmaņa, the enhancer of prosperity.

sa: उत्थाय च यथाकालं राघवः सह सीतया। उपस्पृश्य सुशीतेन तोयेनोत्पलगन्धिना॥ अथ तेऽग्नि सुरांश्चैव वैदेही रामलक्ष्मणौ। काल्यं विधिवदभ्यर्च्य तपस्विशरणे वने॥ उदयन्तं दिनकरं दृष्ट्वा विगतकल्मषाः। सुतीक्ष्णमभिगम्येदं श्लक्ष्णं वचनमब्रुवन्॥
en: And arising in due time, Rāma along with Sītā, bathed in cool waters odorous with the aroma of lotuses; and having in proper time duly worshipped Fire as well as the deities, in that forest containing abodes of ascetics, Rāma, Lakṣmaṇa and Videha's daughter, their sins purged off, seeing the sun risen, approached Sutīksna and spoke to him these mild words.

sa: रामस्तु सहसौमित्रिः सुतीक्ष्णेनाभिपूजितः। परिणाम्य निशां तत्र प्रभाते प्रत्यबुध्यत ॥
en: Having been well entertained by Sutīksna, Rāma in company with Sumitrā's son, having passed away the night there, awoke in the morning.

sa: तान्परिष्वज्य बाहुभ्यामुत्थाप्य च महाबलः। आसनेष्वासतेत्युक्त्वा ततो वाक्यं जगाद ह॥
en: Thereupon having embraced them with his arms he raised up the princes and pressed them to take their seats. Then he said.

sa: षड्भागस्य च भोक्तासौ रक्षते न प्रजाः कथम्। स त्वं पुरुषशार्दूल मार्गस्व विषयं स्वकम्॥ दुष्कृतं यत्र पश्येथास्तत्र यत्नं समाचर।
en: While the king is entitled to the sixth portion of everything why should he not fully protect his subjects? Therefore, O chief of men, do you bring all informations of your kingdom. And be then studious to repress vices wherever you shall find them.

sa: यैर्विवासस्तवारण्ये मिथो राजन् समर्थितः। अरण्ये ते विवत्स्यन्ति चतुर्दश समास्तथा॥
en: Those who have, with one voice oh king, settled about your exile to the forest, shall be banished to-day for fourteen years.

sa: एवं वर्षसहस्राणि दश तेषां ययुस्तदा। धर्मे प्रयतमानानां पौरकार्येषु नित्यदा॥
en: Observing all virtues in this way, Rāma, the foremost of the pious, Bharata and Lakşmaņa governed the subjects for ten thousand years.

sa: निर्मलग्रहनक्षत्रा द्यौः प्रणष्टबलाहका। प्रसन्नाश्च दिशः सर्वाः सरितश्च सरांसि च॥.
en: The sky, having the clouds removed, is full of clear stars and planets. The quarters, the ponds and rivers are all clear.

sa: एते चान्ये च बहव उत्पातास्तत्र दारुणाः। समुत्येतुर्विनाशाय कौरवाणां सुदारुणाः॥
en: Those and other dreadful portends appeared there presaging the destruction of the Kauravas. Stupefied by Destiny they paid no attention of them.

sa: अभिक्रुद्धः समर्थो हि चापमुद्यम्य राघवः। सदेवासुरगन्धर्वं वशे स्थापयितुं जगत्॥
en: Rāghava, taking up his bow, while enraged, can bring under subjection the entire world, inhabited by by the celestials, Asuras and Gandharvas.

sa: ततः पुनरमेयात्मा प्रसंधाय शिलीमुखम्। प्रेषयामास समरे पण्डितं प्रति भारत॥
en: Then that one of immeasurable soul (Bhima), placing on his bow-string another shaft, sped it, O Bharata, against Panditaka in that battle.

sa: मनसा चिन्तितं यच्च यच्च वाचानुकीर्तितम्। सर्वं सम्पद्यते तस्य स्तवस्यास्यानुकीर्तनात्॥
en: On account of the recitation of this wishes one cherishes in his mind and all the wishes he speaks out become successful.

sa: भवेतास्तु यदि प्रज्ञा न मोहादपनीयते। व्यापन्नेऽस्मिन् महत्यर्थे यन्नः श्रेयस्तदुच्यताम्॥
en: If you have not lost your wisdom out of stupefaction, then say what is proper for us to do under these circumstances.

sa: न चैनमशकत् कश्चिन्निवर्तस्वेति भाषितुम्। न्यवर्तन्त ततः सर्वे नरा नगरवासिनः॥
en: None of them, however, could venture to address the king for persuading him so give up his intention. The citizens then returned.

sa: प्रत्याख्याता हि शाल्वेन त्वयाऽऽनीतेति भारत। तस्मादिमा मन्नियोगात् प्रतिगृह्णीष्व भारत॥
en: Having been once led away by you she has been rejected by Shalva; therefore do at my words accept her, O Bharata.

sa: तद्धनुर्नरशार्दूल मैथिलस्य महात्मनः। तत्र द्रक्ष्यसि काकुत्स्थ यज्ञं च परमाद्भुतम्॥
en: There, O Kākutstha, you will behold that bow belonging to the high-souled king of Mithila, as well as his exceedingly wonderful sacrifice..

sa: भीष्म उवाच जामदग्न्येन रामेण पितृर्वधममृध्यता। राजा परशुना पूर्वं हैहयाधिपतिर्हतः॥ शतानि दश बाहूनां निकृत्तान्यर्जुनस्य वै। लोकस्याचरितो धर्मस्तेनाति किल दुश्चरः॥
en: Bhishma said: The king Haihayas was killed by (Parashu) Rama, the son of Jamadagni, with his battle axe from his anger at the death of his father. Cutting off one thousand arms of Arjuna (Haihayas), he achieved a most difficult feat in the world.

sa: स कृत्वा सुमहत् कर्म तस्मिन् वै दशमेऽहनि। सेनयोरन्तरे तिष्ठन् प्रगृहीतशरासनः॥ न चैनं पार्थिवाः केचिच्छक्ता राजन् निरीक्षितुम्।
en: On that the tenth day of the battle, achieving marvelous feats, Bhishma stayed between the two arinies, holding his bow and arrows in his hands. O king, then none of the royal warriors were able to look at him,

sa: चिन्तयामास चतुरो रामः पितृहिते रतः। किंस्विदद्यैव नृपतिर्न मां प्रत्यभिनन्दति॥
en: And clever Rāma, intent on his father's welfare, thought within himself:, Why does not the king display joy on my arrival to-day.

sa: कुम्भकर्णं हतं दृष्ट्वा राघवेण महात्मना। राक्षसा राक्षसेन्द्राय रावणाय न्यवेदयन्॥
en: Seeing Kumbhakarņa slain by the high-souled Rāghava, the Räkşasas conveyed the tidings to the lord of the Raksasas-Ravana; (and addressed him, saying)

sa: अथ द्रोणोऽब्रवीत् तत्र दुर्योधनमिदं वचः। अमर्षवशमापन्नं निःश्वसन्तं पुनः पुनः॥
en: Then did Drona say these words to Duryodhana there who was under the influence of wrath and breathing hard again and again.

sa: सम्प्रयुद्धौ रणे दृष्ट्वा तावुभौ नरराक्षसौ। विस्मयः सर्वभूतानां प्रहर्षः समजायत॥
en: Beholding then that man and that Rakshasa engaged in fighting with each other, all creatures were filled with delight and wonder simultancously.

sa: ततो दिव्यवपुर्भूत्वा धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। निर्वैरो गतसंतापो जले तस्मिन् समाप्लुतः॥
en: Assuming then a celestial form, king Yudhishthira the jut, on account of that bath, became divested of all his enmities and grief.

sa: अपानः प्रचचाराथ व्यानस्तं पुनरब्रवीत्। श्रेष्ठोऽहमस्मि सर्वेषां श्रूयतां येन हेतुना॥
en: Then Apana began to move about, Vyana once more addressed him, saying I am the foremost of all. Listen, for what reason.

sa: अङ्गुष्ठं चरणस्याथ दक्षिणस्यावसेचयेत्॥ पाणिं मूर्ध्नि समाधाय स्पृष्ट्वा चाग्निं समाहितः।
en: After washing, one should touch the crown of his head with the (right) hand. With rapt attention, one should next touch fire.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शूरो दशग्रीवः प्रतापवान्। आरुरोह रथं दिव्यं निर्मितं विश्वकर्मणा।२९।। पन्नगैः सुमहाकायैर्वेष्टितं लोमहर्षणैः। येषां निःश्वासवातेन प्रदीप्तमिव संयुगे॥
en: In the interval the heroic and the highly powerful Daśagrīva ascended the celestial car, constructed by the Architect of the deities, encircled by the huge-bodied serpents capable of making down erect and by whose breath the battle-field was ablaze.

sa: सहदेवस्तु समरे मातुलं दृश्य संगतम्। अवारयच्छरौघेण मेघो यद्वद् दिवाकरम्॥
en: Sahadeva finding himself encountered by his uncle in battle, shrouded him with a network of arrows, like clouds shrouding the solar orb.

sa: सौतिरुवाच इत्युक्तः स तु विप्रर्षिरनुज्ञातो महात्मना। व्यासेन तस्य नृपतेराख्यातुमुपचक्रमे॥
en: Sauti said Thus accosted, that twice-born Rishi, receiving the permission of the great Vyasa, began to answer the question of the king.

sa: महेश्वरच महतां भूतानातीश्वरश्च सः। बहुभिर्बहुधा रूपैर्विश्वं व्याप्नोति वै जगत्॥
en: He is called Maheshvara and he is the supreme lord superior creatures. In multifarious forms of many kinds, he pervades the universe.

sa: गद्गदस्याथ पुत्रोऽन्यो गुरुपुत्रः शतक्रतोः। कदनं यस्य पुत्रेण कृतमेकेन रक्षसाम्॥
en: The other son of Gadgada is the son of Śakra's preceptor. By which son, single-handed, was done immense oppression to the Rākṣasa.

sa: तथा प्रयाते तु रथे तदा भाङ्गासुरिर्नृपः। उत्तरीयमधोऽपश्यद् भ्रष्टं परपुरजयः॥
en: While the car was thus coursing, the conqueror of hostile towns, the king Vangasura, saw his sheet drop down upon the ground.

sa: उपवासश्च कर्तव्यो यथा प्राणेन मैथिलि। जटाभारश्च कर्तव्यो वल्कलाम्बरधारणम्॥ देवतानां पितृणां च कर्तव्यं विधिपूर्वकम्। प्राप्तानामतिथीनां च नित्यशः प्रतिपूजनम्॥ कार्यस्त्रिरभिषेकश्च काले काले च नित्यशः। चरतां नियमेनैव तस्माद् दुःखतरं वनम्॥
en: One has to fast, O Maithili, according to his might, to wear matted hair and bark, to adore the deities and his ancestors according to due rites, every day to serve the guests that come to him, and observing the rules of asceticism, to bathe every day thrice, namely, in the morning, in the mid-day and in the evening; so the wood is full of misery.

sa: तूष्णीम्भावेऽपि विज्ञेयं न चेद्भवति कारणम्। निःश्वासं चोष्ठसंदंशं शिरसश्च प्रकम्पनम्॥
en: Mere silence is no mark of wickedness on such occasions. A wicked person breathes heavily, bites his lips, and snakes his head.

sa: अथ सूर्यसहस्रस्य प्रभां युगपदुत्थिताम्॥ सहसा दृष्टवन्तः स्म पुनरेव बृहस्पते।
en: We then suddenly saw once more a light arise that seemed to be the concentrated effulgence of a thousand Sons, O Brihaspati.

sa: पुनश्च तादृशीमेव वापी जलजशालिनीम्। मत्वा शिलासमां तोये पतितोऽस्मि नराधिप॥
en: O king, again seeing a similar lake full of water, I mistook it for a crystal surface, and I fell into it.

sa: एष सेना: सुबहुला विविधायुधकार्मुकाः। अग्निवत् समरे तात चरिष्यति विनिर्दहन्॥
en: Destroying this army strong in numbers and furnished with diverse weapons and bows he will roll in the battle like blazing fire.

sa: तस्य प्राग्ज्योतिषः क्रुद्धस्तोमरांश्च चतुर्दश। प्रेषयामास समरे ताश्चिच्छेद स राक्षसः॥
en: The ruler of the Pragjyotishas inflamed with rage, in that battle sped fourteen Tomaras against the Rakshasas, who (easily) cut them off.

sa: नखदंष्ट्रायुधाः क्रूर मन:संपातरंहसः। युद्धोन्मत्ता बलोद्रिक्ताः शैला इव विसर्पिणः॥ ते तव प्रबलं दर्पमुत्सेधं च पृथग्विधम्। व्यपनेष्यन्ति संभूय सहामात्यमुतस्य च॥
en: And armed with teeth and claws, and fierce and furnished with the fleetness of thought, and mad for encounter, and bursting with vigour, and resembling moving mountains and being born, they shall crush your high pride and power along with your courtiers and sons.

sa: यान्यकार्याणि चास्माकं कृतानीति प्रभाषसे॥ वैगुण्येन तवात्यर्थं सर्वं हि तदनुष्ठितम्।
en: All those sinful deeds which you attribute to us have in reality been perpetrated by you in consequence of your sinful nature!

sa: संजय उवाच ततस्ते सहिता वीराः प्रयाता दक्षिणामुखाः। उपास्तमनवेलायां शिविराभ्याशमागताः॥
en: Sanjaya said “Those heroes then in a body went towards the south. At sunset they reached a spot near the (Kuru) encampment.

sa: शमं चेद् याचमानं त्वं प्रत्याख्यास्यसि केशवम्। त्वदर्थमभिजल्पन्तं न तवास्त्यपराभवः॥
en: If you abandon peace which is begged from you for the accomplishment of your own good, then will victory never be yours."

sa: अनक्षज्ञं च धर्मज्ञं सौबलेनाक्षवेदिना॥ निकृत्या यत् पराजैषीस्तस्मादसि हतो रणे।
en: Through Subala's son an expert in dice, you unfairly defeated the virtuous Yudhishthira who was unskilled in gambling! For that are killed.

sa: मकरा इव राजेन्द्र समुद्धततरङ्गिणीम्। गङ्गा विक्षोभयिष्यन्ति पार्थानां युधि वाहिनीम्॥
en: In the battle, they will agitate the army of the son of Pritha like Makaras agitating the Ganga swollen with its waves.

sa: सुग्रीवेण तु निःशक़ सालमुत्पाट्य तेजसा। गात्रेष्वभिहतो वाली वज्रेणेव महागिरिः॥
en: And Vāli too was struck down by Sugrīva, fearlessly taking up a Sāla tree, like to a mountain clapped by a thunderbolt.

sa: सा नियुक्ता पितुर्गेह देवतातिथिपूजने। उग्रं पर्यचरत् तत्र ब्राह्मणं संशितव्रतम्॥ निगूढनिश्चयं धर्मे यं तं दुर्वाससं विदुः। तमुग्रं संशितात्मानं सर्वयत्नैरतोषयत्॥
en: She (Pritha) was appointed as her (adoptive) father's house to look after the hospitality to the Brahmanas and guests. One day by careful attentions she gratified the terrible Brahmana of rigid vows, known by the name of Durvasa, learned in the mystery of religion.

sa: तदादाय धनुः श्रेष्ठं वरिष्ठः सर्वधन्विनाम्॥ हार्दिक्यं दशभिर्बाणैः प्रत्यविध्यत् स्तनान्तरे।
en: Having taken up that best of bows, that first of bowmen struck the son of Hridika with ten arrows on the chest.

sa: पितामहस्य द्रोणस्य विदुरस्य महामतेः। कृपस्य सोमदत्तस्य बाह्रीकस्य च धीमतः॥
en: As also to your grandfather and Drona and Vidura of great intelligence and to Kripa and Somadatta and to the wise Balhika,

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तान्यनीकान्यदृश्यन्त कुरूणामुग्रधन्विनाम्। संसर्पन्ते यथा मेघा धर्मान्ते मन्दमारुताः॥
en: Vaishampayana said The infantry of those dreadful Kuru bowmen looked like the clouds in the rains moving about before the gentle wind.

sa: सूतस्त्वधिरथः पुत्रं विवृद्धं समयेन तम्। दृष्ट्वा प्रस्थापयामास पुरं वारणसाह्वयम्॥
en: When the charioteer saw that his son in course of time had grown up, he sent him to the city of Hastina.

sa: स भवान् धर्मपुत्रेण शमं कर्तुमिहार्हति। पाण्डवाः कुरवश्चैव पालयन्तु वसुंधराम्॥
en: Therefore it is proper for your exalted self to effect peace with Yudhishthira. Let the Pandavas and the Kurus rule the universe.

sa: त्रिविधं नरकस्येदं द्वारं नाशनमात्मनः। कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभस्तस्मादेतत् त्रयं त्यजेत्॥
en: These three are the way to hell and destruction of self viz., desire, anger and greed; therefore should these three be renounced.

sa: ततः संचिन्त्य मनसा मुहूर्तमिव वासवः। शक्त्यर्थं पृथिवीपाल कर्णं वाक्यमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: Thereupon, O lord of the earth, Vasava reflecting a moment with in his mind for the dart, spoke to Karna these words.

sa: सुवर्णपुष्पां पृथिवीं चिन्वन्ति पुरुषास्त्रयः। शूरश्च कृतविद्यश्च यश्च जानाति सेवितुम्॥
en: These three, viz., the brave, the wise and these who know how to protect others, plucks flowers of gold from the earth.

sa: धृतराष्ट्रमभिप्रेक्ष्य सुहृदां शृण्वतां मिथः। राजनेते यदि क्रुद्धा मां निगृह्णीयुरोजसा॥
en: Looking on Dhritarashtra and in the hearing of his well-wishers "O king, if being angry they can by their might capture me,

sa: अभिशापादहं भीतो मिथ्यावादात् परंतप। स्नुषार्थमुत्तरां राजन् प्रतिगृह्णामि ते सुताम्॥
en: O king, I am afraid of curses and false accusation. O king, I shall therefore accept your daughter Uttara as my daughter-in-law.

sa: सर्वराक्षसराज्ये चाप्यभ्यषिञ्चद् विभीषणम्। चक्रे च मन्त्रसचिवं सुहृदं लक्ष्मणस्य च॥
en: And he installed him in sovereignty over all the Rakshasas and made him his junior adviser and a friend of Lakshmana's. was

sa: यक्ष उवाच अहं बकः शैवलमत्स्यभक्षो नीता मया प्रेतवशं तवानुजाः। त्वं पञ्चमो भविता राजपुत्र न चेत् प्रश्नान् पृच्छतो व्याकरोषि॥
en: The Yaksha said: I am a crane living on moss and fish. Your younger brothers have been, by me, brought under the control of death. If, O king's son, you do not answer the questions put by me, you shall be the fifth victim.

sa: भीमस्तु भीमसंकाशो रथात् प्रस्कन्ध पाण्डवः। प्राद्रवत् तूर्णमव्यग्रो जीवितेप्सुः सुशर्मणः॥४६
en: Getting down from the car the dreadful Bhimasena, the son of Pandu, rushed towards him with coolness, desirous of taking Susharma's life.

sa: तपोमूलमिदं सर्वं यन्मां पृच्छसि क्षत्रिय। तपसा वेदविद्वांसः परं त्वतमाप्नुयुः॥
en: What you ask me, O Kshatriya, have all their bases on asceticism do learned men know the Supreme Soul and win immortality.

sa: तथाधिगम्य वित्तानि को विकत्थेद् विचक्षणः। निकृत्या वञ्चनायोगैश्चरन् वैतंसिको यथा।॥
en: Having acquired riches in this way by deceit and fraud like a seller of meat what wise man would boast of it?

sa: यक्ष उवाच किं स्थैर्यगृषिभिः प्रोक्तं किं च धैर्यमुदाहृतम्। स्नानं च किं परं प्रोक्तं दानं च किमिहोच्यते॥
en: The Yaksha said : What is it that is spoken of as steadiness by the Rishis? What is it that is instanced as patience? What is said to be the highest ablution? And what is spoken of as charity?

sa: गजैर्मत्तैः समाकीर्णं सवर्मायुधकोशकैः। तद् बभूव बलं राजन् कौरव्यस्य महात्मनः॥
en: That army of the great-souled Kurus, O king, was full of infuriated animals and was furnished with all necessary weapons and treasuries.

sa: प्राप्य द्यूतेन को राज्यं क्षत्रियस्तोष्टुमर्हति। तथा नृशंसरूपोऽयं धार्तराष्ट्रश्च निघृणः॥
en: What Kshatriya on this earth expresses joy for having acquired a kingdom by gambling like this wicked and shameless son of Dhritarashtra?

sa: तेषां समुपविष्टानां बहूनां दुष्टचेतसाम्। कथं मध्यं प्रपद्येथाः शत्रूणां शत्रुकर्शन॥
en: Among those men, your enemies any in number, of wicked hearts seated together how will you go, O grinder of your enemies.

sa: पाण्डुरेणातपत्रेण ध्रियमाणेन मूर्धनि। शुशुभे स नरव्याघ्रो गिरिः सूर्योदये यथा।॥
en: And on account of a white umbrella being held over his head, that foremost of men shone like a hill at sun-rise.

sa: दहत्यग्निरवाक्यस्तु तूष्णीं भाति दिवाकरः। तूष्णीं धारयते लोकान् वसुधा सचराचरान्॥
en: Fire burns silently and silently does the sun shine. And the earth does bear creatures mobile and immobile without a single word.

sa: यथाशक्ति चिकीर्षन्ति यथाशक्ति च कुर्वते। न किंचिदवमन्यन्ते नराः पण्डितबुद्धयः॥
en: Wise men exert to the best of their ability and also act to the best of their ability and they disregard nothing.

sa: सात्यकिरुवाच यादृशः पुरुषस्यात्मा तादृशं सम्प्रभाषते। यथारूपोऽन्तरात्मा ते तथारूपं प्रभाषसे।।।।
en: Satyaki said As the inner nature of a man is, so he speaks. As your inner nature is, so do you speak.

sa: किष्किन्धाद्वारमासाद्य प्रविवेशानिवारितः। सक्रोध इति तं मत्वा राजा प्रत्युद्ययौ हरिः॥
en: And reaching the gate of Kishkindha he entered (the city) unopposed. The monkey-king deeming him to be angry advanced (to meet him).

sa: राक्षसीभिः परिवृता वैदेही शोककर्शिता। सेव्यमाना त्रिजटया तत्रैव न्यवसत् तदा।॥
en: And the princess of Videha weighed down with grief continued to dwell there, surrounded by Rakshasa women and kindly treated by Trijata.

sa: नराश्वकायान् निर्भिद्य लौहानि कवचानि च। पार्थस्य शरजालानि विनिष्पेतुः सहस्रशः॥
en: Piercing the bodies of elephants and horses as also the iron coats of mail, the arrows of Partha dropped down in thousands.

sa: ततस्तमपि कौन्तेयः शरेणानतपर्वणा। ललाटेऽभ्यहनत् तूर्णं स विद्धः प्रापतद् रथात्॥
en: Immediately also the son of Kunti wounded him on his forehead with straight arrows. Thus wounded, he fell down from his chariot.

sa: भ्राता चास्य महाबाहुः सौमित्रिरपराजितः। लक्ष्मणो नाम मेधावी स्थितः कार्यार्थसिद्धये॥
en: His brother, the intellectual Lakshmana of mighty arms, the ever-victorious son of Sumitra, stands by him for the furtherance of Sugriva's aims.

sa: इन्द्रसेनमुखाश्चेमे रथानादाय केवलान्। यान्तु द्वारवतीं शीघ्रमिति मे वर्तते मतिः॥
en: Let these people with Indrasena as their head repair speedily with empty cars to the city of Amaravati. This is my wish.

sa: गन्धेन मूर्च्छितश्चाहं वसारुधिरमेदसाम्। द्वैधीभूतं मनो मेऽद्य तव चैव प्रपश्यतः॥
en: I am beside myself with the smell of flesh, blood and fat. Beholding your feat, my mind has been divided in twain.

sa: सा ददर्श गिरिप्रस्थे पञ्च वानरपुङ्गवान्। तत्र वासो महद्दिव्यमुत्ससर्ज मनस्विनी॥
en: That intelligent lady saw on a mountainpeak five foremost of monkeys and there she threw down a highly beautiful piece of cloth.

sa: तामभिद्रुत्य सुश्रोणी रावणः प्रत्यषेधयत्। भर्त्सयित्वा तु रूक्षेण स्वरेण गतचेतनाम्॥
en: (But) Ravana, pursuing that lady of beautiful lips, cut off her retreat. And harshly scolded by Ravana she fell into a soon.

sa: अत्र शान्तनवो भीष्मो रथेऽस्माकं पितामहः। काङ्क्षमाणो मया युद्धं तिष्ठत्यमरदर्शनः॥
en: There our grand-father, Bhishma the son of Shantanu looking like an immortal, wait on his car, desirous of an encounter with me.

sa: सर्वधर्मविशेषज्ञां स्नुषां पाण्डोर्महात्मनः। ब्रूया माधव कल्याणी कृष्ण कृष्णां यशस्विनीम्॥
en: O Madhava, O Krishna, tell that blessed lady of renown-the daughter-in-law of the great-souled Pandu, who is especially conversant with all virtues.

sa: स राजधानी सम्प्राप्य कौन्तेयोऽर्जुनमब्रवीत्। क्वायुधानि समासज्ज्य प्रवेक्ष्यामः पुरं वयम्॥
en: After having arrived at the capital the son of Kunti, asked Arjuna-where shall we keep our weapons before we enter the city?

sa: उवाच वदतां श्रेष्ठः सान्त्वपूर्वमिदं वचः। पर्याक्रामत सैन्यानि यत्तास्तिष्ठत दंशिताः॥
en: That foremost of speakers said these words in a calm spirit: “Go round the army and remain watchful being clad in mail.

sa: उपप्लुतं यथा सोमं राहुणा रात्रिसंक्षये। उपागम्याब्रवीत् कर्णो दुर्योधनमिदं तदा।॥
en: Himself looking like the moon under eclipse. At the end of the night, Karna came to Duryodhana and thus spoke to him,

sa: इदं पुनर्वचनं धार्तराष्ट्र सुयोधनं संजय श्रावयेथाः। यस्ते शरीरे हृदयं दुनोति कामः कुरूनसपत्नोऽनुशिष्याम्॥ त्रैवंविधाः स्याम यथा प्रियं ते। ददस्व वा शक्रपुरी ममैव युध्यस्व वा भारतमुख्य वीर॥
en: You should, O Sanjaya, make Suyodhana, the son of Dhritarashtra hear these words "The desire which is tormenting your heart, to rule the Kurus without any rival, has no justification for it. We shall do nothing that will not be agreeable to you. Either give me back the city of Indra or fight, you chief hero among the race of Bharata."

sa: ये त्वानुवादेऽयुरवृत्तिकर्शिता ब्रूयाश्च तेषां वचनेन मां सदा। दास्यामि सर्वं तदहं न संशयो न ते भयं विद्यति संनिधौ मम॥
en: When the people pressed by the want of employment, will apply to you, you shall at all hours tell me all their words. I shall undoubtedly give them all that they will ask for, before iny presence there will be no fear to you.

sa: तां तथा विकृतां दृष्ट्वा रावणः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः। उत्पपातासनात् क्रुद्धो दन्तैर्दन्तानुपस्पृशन्॥
en: Seeing her thus multilated Ravana became senseless with rage and fired with anger and gnashing his teeth, rose up from his throne.

sa: तमेव दिवसं चापि कौन्तेयः पाण्डुनन्दनः। आनर्तनगरी रम्या जगामाशु धनंजयः॥
en: That very day had Dhananjaya, the son of Kunti, of the race of Pandu, arrived at the beautiful city of the Anartas.

sa: तं प्रयान्तमनुप्रायात् कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। भीमसेनार्जुनौ चोभो माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ।॥ चेकितानश्च विक्रान्तो धृष्टकेतुश्च चेदिपः। दुपदः काशिराजश्च शिखण्डी च महारथः॥ धृष्टद्युम्नः सपुत्रश्च विराटः केकयैः सह। संसाधनार्थ प्रययुः क्षत्रियाः क्षत्रियर्षभ॥
en: Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti, Bhimasena and Arjuna and the two descendants of Pandu-the two sons of Madri followed him as he proceeded along. The powerful Chekitana and Dhrishtaketu, the lord of the Chedis, Drupada, Kashi and the great car-warrior Shikhandi and Dhrishtadyumna and Virata in company with his sons, the Kaikeya princes, all Kshatriyas followed the bull of the Kshatriya race to attain his object.

sa: तदर्थमवतीर्णोऽसौ मन्नियोगाच्चतुर्भुजः। विष्णुः प्रहरतां श्रेष्ठः स तत् कर्म करिष्यति।॥
en: For this purpose and at my command the four-headed god has already been incarnated; Vishnu, the foremost of repressors, shall accomplish this.

sa: जवेन वाजिनोऽत्येति बलेनात्येति कुञ्चरान्। अव्यक्तजपी मध्वक्षो मध्यमः पाण्डवो बली॥
en: Surpassing in speed the horses, in strength the elephants, the second son of Pandu who is of great strength has sweet eyes.

sa: खानयामास परिखां केशवस्तत्र भारत। गुप्त्यर्थमपि चादिश्य बलं तत्र न्यवेशयत्॥
en: Keshava had a trench dug there, O Bharata and for the protection thereof posted a body of soldiers with instructions to them.

sa: श्लाघस्व मां कुशलिनं स्म तेभ्यो ह्यनामयं तात पृच्छेर्जघन्यम्। ये जीवन्ति व्यवहारेण राष्ट्र ये पालयन्तो निवसन्ति राष्ट्रे॥
en: Inform them of my good health and enquire of them about theirs, as also those who live in the kingdom carrying on the traders and those who live in the kingdom maintaining it (by filling offices of the state).

sa: द्रोणस्य पुङ्खसक्ताच प्रभवन्तः शरासनात्। एको दीर्घ इवादृश्यदाकाशे संहतः शरः॥
en: The arrows shot from Drona's bow touching one another by the wings appeared like one long-extending row of arrows in the sky.

sa: स तासां भगवांस्तुष्टो महात्मा प्रददौ वरान्। लोकपालोपमान् पुत्रानेकैकस्या यथेप्सितान्॥
en: Being pleased with them, the high-souled sage conferred boons on them-and on each of them sons like Lokapalas according to their desire.

sa: स विस्फार्य धनुः श्रेष्ठं मेघस्तनितनिस्वनम्॥ अग्निचक्रोपमं घोरं व्यकर्षत् परमायुधम्।
en: He, drawing his excellent bow making a sound like that of clouds, took up a huge weapon like a wheel of fire.

sa: तत्रापश्याम वै सर्वे मधु पीतकमाक्षिकम्। मरुप्रपाते विषमे निविष्टं कुम्भसम्मितम्॥
en: There we all saw some honey of a yellow colour inside a pot placed at a very high point of the mountain.

sa: पितरं स समुत्सृज्य पितामहमुपस्थितः। तस्य कोपात् पिता राजन् ससर्जात्मानमात्मा॥
en: Leaving his father he went to his grandfather. Accordingly worked up with anger, O king, he created a second self of himself.

sa: आश्रमाद् राक्षसेन्द्रेण रावणेन दुरात्मना। मायामास्थाय तरसा हत्वा गृधं जटायुषम्॥
en: Resorting to Maya and having slain the vulture Jatayu, the vicious-souled Ravana, the king of Rakshasas (carried her away) from the hermitage.

sa: समुपानय कौन्तेयं युद्धायं मम केशव। मन्त्रसंवरणं कुर्वन् नित्यमेव परंतप॥
en: Bring here the son of Kunti for me to fight, O Keshava, for ever keeping this conversation secret, О chastiser of foes.

sa: कृत्वा चाङ्गारको वक्र ज्येष्ठायां मधुसूदन। अनुराधां प्रार्थयते मैत्रं संगमयन्निव॥
en: The planet Angaraka travels obliquely to the constellation Jyeshtha, O Slayer of Madhu, and goes towards Anuradha as if seeking its friendship.

sa: किं चैतन्मन्यसे कृच्छ्रमस्माकमवसादकम्। कुर्वन्ति तेषां कर्माणि येषां नास्ति फलोदयः॥
en: You consider peace to be improbable owing to our weakness; but they are doing deeds, which do not seem to bear fruits.

sa: स लभेयं यदा त्वन्यं हययानविदं नरम्। त्वरावानद्य यात्वाहं समुच्छितमहाध्वजम्॥
en: As soon as I shall get a man experienced in the management of horses I shall immediately start hoisting the huge standard.

sa: पलायनकृतोत्साहः प्राद्रवद् येन वै वनम्। सैन्धवं त्वभिसम्प्रेक्ष्य पराक्रान्तं पलायने॥
en: Determined on flying away he followed the same forest path by which he had come. Beholding Saindhava thus engaged in flying away.

sa: समये मुच्यमानस्य सर्पस्येव तनुर्यथा॥ छिन्ने धनुषि पार्थेन सोऽन्यदादाय कार्मुकम्।
en: Like a serpent casting off its coating at the proper time. On his bow being cut off by Partha, taking up another.

sa: उत्तरश्चापि संलीनो रथोपस्थ उपाविशत्॥ तस्य शङ्खस्य शब्देन स्थनेमिस्वनेन च।
en: (It seemed to rend) the caves of the mountains, hills and the quarters. Uttara too, clinging to it, sat on the car.

sa: तदैव निहतो राजन् यदैव निरपत्रपः। निन्दितश्च महाराज पृथिव्या सर्वराजभिः॥
en: Since that time is he dead, when he was without shame, though blamed by all the kings on earth, O great king.

sa: निर्जित्य नरकं भौममाहृत्य मणिकुण्डले। षोडश स्त्रीसहस्राणि रत्नानि विविधानि च॥
en: And subjugating Naraka the son of Bhumi (earth) while recovering the jeweled ear-rings and sixteen thousand damsels and diverse sorts of gems,

sa: आनुपूर्व्यात् तु तत् सर्वमास्थाय जवमुत्तमम्। प्राहिणोच्चन्द्रसंकाशान् कुपितानिव तान् हयान्॥
en: Making them one by one proceed by swifter course, he urged those those horses resembling the moon as if they were angry.

sa: तस्य तत् कुर्वतः कर्म कालो दीर्घ इवाभवत्। अनुचिन्तयतश्चापि तामेवायतलोचनाम्॥ आसीदभ्यधिका चापि श्रीः श्रियं प्रमुमुक्षतः। निर्वाणकाले दीपस्य वर्तीमिव दिधक्षतः॥
en: He, then possessed by lust adorned himself speedily. While he was doing this and thinking of the female with large eyes, the time appeared to him to be long; and the beauty which was about to forsake him, appeared to him to be increased,

sa: अथैनमाक्षिप्य बलाद् गृहमध्ये वृकोदरः। धूनयामास वेगेन वायुश्चण्ड इव दुमम्॥
en: Then throwing Kichaka down with great force in the room, Vrikodara tossed him about with velocity, as a hurricane tosses a tree.

sa: तस्यां रजन्यां व्युष्टायां राजानः सर्व एव ते। सभामाविविशुहृष्टाः सूतस्योपदिदृक्षया॥
en: That night having passed away, all the kings entered the Council Chamber with glad hearts with the desire of seeing the Suta.

sa: पितृपैतामहं राज्यं प्राप्स्यस्यमितविक्रम। वर्षात् त्रयोदशादूर्ध्वं व्येतु ते मानसो ज्वरः॥
en: O undeterioratingly powerful one, after the thirteenth year has passed away, you will get back the kingdom of your father and grandfather.

sa: अङ्के कुरुष्व राजानं धृतराष्ट्र युधिष्ठिरम्। युध्यतोर्हि द्वयोर्युद्धे नैकान्तेन भवेज्जयः॥
en: 0 Dhritarashtra, take the king Yudhishthira on your lap; for by a struggle between you two none can get an absolute victory.

sa: ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वा यक्षरक्षोमहोरगाः। ऋषयश्च महेन्द्रं तमस्तुवन् विविधैः स्तवैः॥
en: And then the gods along with the Gandharvas, Yakshas, Rakshasas and Pannagas and the Rishis propitiated the great Indra with diverse hymns.

sa: कीर्यमाणाः शरौघैस्तु योधास्ते पार्थचोदितैः। नापश्यन्नावृतां भूमिं नान्तरिक्षं च पत्रिभिः॥
en: Assailed by the mass of shafts discharged by Partha the warriors couldn't see anything, the sky and the earth being covered therewith.

sa: विष्णुं त्रिभुवनश्रेष्ठं पूजयामास धर्मवित्। ततो हते महावीर्ये वृत्रे देवभयंकरे॥
en: The one knowing virtue worshipped the foremost in the three worlds, Vishnu, after the great hero and fierce god Vritra was slain.

sa: ततः समन्तात् पश्यामः शरजालेन वेष्टितम्। अमानुषाणि चास्त्राणि प्रमुञ्चन्तं धनंजयम्॥
en: Then we saw a net-work of arrows all around us spread out by Dharmaraja who was shooting extraordinary weapons on the enemy.
